Of them, vira-Nṛisimhēndra obtained his father's kingdom. His praises. In
Kāñchī, Śrīraṅga, Śēshāchala, Garuḍagiri, Gōkarṇa, Śrīnāgēndra, Aruṇāśikhari,
and the temple of Virūpāksha, did he make the brahmāṇḍa, svarṇa-mēru,
tridaśa- taru-latā, kāma-dhēnu, and other great gifts again and again. The
Aṅga, Vaṅga, Kaliṅga and other kings waited on him as servants, holding
the chāmaras and other royal insignia.

(With usual titles), this vira-Nṛisimhēndra, (on the date specified), after
setting up the god Lakshmi-Nṛisimha, on the bank of the Tuṅgabhadrā,
adorned by Hēmakūṭa, in the presence of the god Virūpāksha, to many
Brāhmans of various gōtras etc. gave the Nalabaṇḍehaḷḷi village, otherwise
called Narasimhapuram, with its hamlet Guṅguḷḷuvāyi, belonging to Midigēsi,
attached to Bāti-nagara in the Ghanaśailapuri kingdom (bounded as specified),
with all usual rights, as an agrahāra of 15 shares. (List of donees.)
Boundaries in the Karṇāṭa language.

Usual final imprecatory verses.
This śāsana of vira-Nṛisimhēndra was composed by Narasimhārya, and
engraved by the carpenter Janārdana.

(signed) śrī-Virūpāksha.

cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ನಂಜೆರಲು ಗ್ರಾಮದ ನಾಗಂಗೇನ ಹೌಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡೇ ಮೇಲೆ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 10' 6″ X 3' 9″.

On a natural boulder in the field of Nāgengēna at Nanjeralu village in the same hobli. Size 10' 6″ X 3' 9″.

[Footnote 1]ಶುಭಮಸ್ತು ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕವರಷಂಬುಲು ಒಳರ್ಬ ಅಗುನನೇಹೇಮಲಂಬವತ್ಸರದಶ್ರಾವಣ
[Footnote 2]ಗ೧ಲು ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಶ್ರೀ ವೀರಪ್ರತಾಪಪ್ರೌಢಮುಹಾರಾಯಮಹಾರಾಯರುಪ್ರುಥ್ವಿರಾ
ಜ್ಯಂಗೈಯೂತುದುಗಾನ೯ಲಚ್ಯುತರಾಯಮಹಲ್ಲಪಂಗಾರಿಕೀಭರದ್ವಾಜ
[Footnote 3] . . ತ್ಯಾಯಿನಸು . . .ಶಾ . . . ಯುಲ್ದಿನಭಂಡಾರಲಅಪ್ಪರಸಂ. ಕೋಮೂರುತಿವಂದಿರಸುಂಗಾ. ರಾಯಪ್ಪಂಗಾರುನು
ಕೊಂಡೆಪ್ಪಗೌರೇನುರಾಯಪ್ಪಂಗಾರುನುಜನೆಲಗರುನುಸಹಮಟುಲೋನು....
[Footnote 4]ಇಚ್ಚಿ ನಗಾನಮುಂಡಾನಪತ್ರಮನು....ಪೆನಗೋಗೇರಾಜುಕರಕಿ ಕಂಸಲಬುಸಲಂಡಕಂಟೇಸೀಮಲೋನುಮಾಣಿಕ್ಕಿಷ್ಥಾವತಿಪ್ರೆಂದ
ಯಂಗಾರಿವಲಮವಾರವರ್ಜೆತಮುಗಾರಿನುವಚಿ ನಟುವಂಟಿವರು....
[Footnote 5] ನಸ್ಥ . . . ನೀವೆರಂಸಹೀಪುರಮನಿಪ್ರತಿಮಾಮಗಳನಂದಿಕೇಯವನೇಗಾ)ನುಮಮುಆಚ್ಯುತರಾಯುಮಲ್ಲದರನಸೀಭಾರದ್ವಾಜ
ಗೋತ್ರಕಂತ್ಯಾಯಿನಸುಗೌತುಕ೯ಕ ಯಜಸ್ಕಬಾಹ್ಯದಯಲುನಿಬಂಧದಾರೆಅಪ್ಪರ...

6ತಿಂಮಪ್ಪಗರು ನಡಯುಗ್ಗರುಗರು ನೂಂಕತ್ತ್ಯಗರು ನಂರಾಯಮವುಂನಜನನಲಗುರುಂ ನುತಮುಲೋಣಪಕಸ್ಥಿಲ್ಲಿ
ಭುಟ್ಟ ಪೂಜೆ ಕೊಂಡುನಕಾಳೋಚಿತಮದ್ಯುಸ್ತ ಪರಕಲ್ಲಿ . . .
7 . . . . ಅಕ್ಷರನವಶರುವಂ . . ಲೂ . . . ಚಿಕಂಕುರಾಣುಮಿಜಿಕೆ ಜೀರಿನಂಕಿೋನಿಂದಿರುರುವಿನೇರ್ಗಾಮುಮುಆಜ್ಯ್ವತ
ರಾಯಮುಲ . . . . ಗಾರಿಕೋಬಾರ . . ಗೋತ್ರ ಕತಾಯಾನನಸೊಂ . . .
8 . . . . ಅಪ್ಸರಯ್ಯ್ಕೋಳವರಾಂತಿನುಂಮ್ಯ್ಗಾರುಂ . . ಯುಷ್ಪಗಾರನೋಣಜುಂ ಧಮ್ಮಗಾರುನ್ನು ರಾಮಪ್ಪಗಾರು ನುಪವನಲಗು
ರುನ್ನು ಕ್ಯಾಯಮಿಸ್ಟಿ ವಿಗನುಕಯ್ಯ್ಕಾನುಮುತೋಗೇನಿಸಿನಿ್ವಲುಲೋಗಿನುಹ . . . ಹ್ಗೆತ್ರನಿಧಿನಿಕ್ಷೇಪವಲ
9 . . . . ವೃಥೋನೇಳಪ್ಪಭೋಗ . . . ಉಬನನ್ನ ಸರ್ವೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಸವಸ್ತ ಭಳಸಿತಮುಗುನ್ನು ಸಿಪ್ರುತದಾಯಾನಿಂದಿಾಗ್ಗಿ ತ್ರೀಸಾ
ಮನ್ನು ಲುಖವಮ್ಯ್ಕಾನವಾಸವಾ ಮುಕ್ತ ಹನಸ್ಯರಮ್ಯ್ಕಾನುಸತ್ಯಪರಿಶೋಧ . ಗಾಸುರ್ಕಯುದಿನಂ
10 . . . ಮಿಗ್ಗಾನವಾಲುಯುಗ್ಗಾಮವುಮುಡನಾಚಿನಿವಿನಯುಯಾಕ್ಯ್ವಲುಲ ಭೋಗಮ್ಯ್ಮುಯಿನತುಗಾನಅನುಭವಂ . . . ಅವಾಲುಅತಿನೆ
ಮುಪ್ಪುರuj . . . ವುಂರಂಭೊಯಿಟಿನಕೆಯದಾನವಸತ್ಪರಿಯೊಂಯುರುಕಸಾಹೃಲೋಕತಿಪ್ರದೀಕ್ಷಿಥ . . .
11 ಚೋಡು . . . ಹರೋಂತಅಉಳಫಲನಿ . . . ತುಯಾದುಲು . . . ವಿನಬನವರಿದಕ್ಷಿತಲುನಸಂಮತಿಚೇವಿಬಡಿಸಿಂಗ್ರಯುವಾಸಿನದಾನ
ಸಕ್ತಯಪತ್ರಿಯಿಪಾತ್ಕಾಲುಳಿಪ್ಪೆನ್ಯ್ಕಾಲುವಾಲುತಿದಿ . . ನ . . . ರಾಯದುಪ್ಪನವರಹ . . .
12ಭಂಡಾರ . . . ಅನುಮತಿಯೊಬರಹನಮುಪ್ಪುರನಮತಿಯರಹಸಸಾಕ್ಷಿಲು, . ವೋಲಳಸೋಮೇವಅಪ್ಪೀರಲಾಸಾಕ್ಷಿ * ಬಲ್.,ಯು
ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯ

Size 10' 6″ X 3' 9″.[Footnote 1]ಶುಭಮಸ್ತು ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕವರಷಂಬುಲು ಒಳರ್ಬ ಅಗುನನೇಹೇಮಲಂಬವತ್ಸರದಶ್ರಾವಣ[Footnote 2]ಗ೧ಲು ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ಮಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಶ್ರೀ ವೀರಪ್ರತಾಪಪ್ರೌಢಮುಹಾರಾಯಮಹಾರಾಯರುಪ್ರುಥ್ವಿರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೈಯೂತುದುಗಾನ೯ಲಚ್ಯುತರಾಯಮಹಲ್ಲಪಂಗಾರಿಕೀಭರದ್ವಾಜ[Footnote 3] . . ತ್ಯಾಯಿನಸು . . .ಶಾ . . . ಯುಲ್ದಿನಭಂಡಾರಲಅಪ್ಪರಸಂ. ಕೋಮೂರುತಿವಂದಿರಸುಂಗಾ. ರಾಯಪ್ಪಂಗಾರುನುಕೊಂಡೆಪ್ಪಗೌರೇನುರಾಯಪ್ಪಂಗಾರುನುಜನೆಲಗರುನುಸಹಮಟುಲೋನು....[Footnote 4]ಇಚ್ಚಿ ನಗಾನಮುಂಡಾನಪತ್ರಮನು....ಪೆನಗೋಗೇರಾಜುಕರಕಿ ಕಂಸಲಬುಸಲಂಡಕಂಟೇಸೀಮಲೋನುಮಾಣಿಕ್ಕಿಷ್ಥಾವತಿಪ್ರೆಂದಯಂಗಾರಿವಲಮವಾರವರ್ಜೆತಮುಗಾರಿನುವಚಿ ನಟುವಂಟಿವರು....[Footnote 5] ನಸ್ಥ . . . ನೀವೆರಂಸಹೀಪುರಮನಿಪ್ರತಿಮಾಮಗಳನಂದಿಕೇಯವನೇಗಾ)ನುಮಮುಆಚ್ಯುತರಾಯುಮಲ್ಲದರನಸೀಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಗೋತ್ರಕಂತ್ಯಾಯಿನಸುಗೌತುಕ೯ಕ ಯಜಸ್ಕಬಾಹ್ಯದಯಲುನಿಬಂಧದಾರೆಅಪ್ಪರ...6ತಿಂಮಪ್ಪಗರು ನಡಯುಗ್ಗರುಗರು ನೂಂಕತ್ತ್ಯಗರು ನಂರಾಯಮವುಂನಜನನಲಗುರುಂ ನುತಮುಲೋಣಪಕಸ್ಥಿಲ್ಲಿಭುಟ್ಟ ಪೂಜೆ ಕೊಂಡುನಕಾಳೋಚಿತಮದ್ಯುಸ್ತ ಪರಕಲ್ಲಿ . . .7 . . . . ಅಕ್ಷರನವಶರುವಂ . . ಲೂ . . . ಚಿಕಂಕುರಾಣುಮಿಜಿಕೆ ಜೀರಿನಂಕಿೋನಿಂದಿರುರುವಿನೇರ್ಗಾಮುಮುಆಜ್ಯ್ವತರಾಯಮುಲ . . . . ಗಾರಿಕೋಬಾರ . . ಗೋತ್ರ ಕತಾಯಾನನಸೊಂ . . .8 . . . . ಅಪ್ಸರಯ್ಯ್ಕೋಳವರಾಂತಿನುಂಮ್ಯ್ಗಾರುಂ . . ಯುಷ್ಪಗಾರನೋಣಜುಂ  ಧಮ್ಮಗಾರುನ್ನು ರಾಮಪ್ಪಗಾರು ನುಪವನಲಗುರುನ್ನು ಕ್ಯಾಯಮಿಸ್ಟಿ ವಿಗನುಕಯ್ಯ್ಕಾನುಮುತೋಗೇನಿಸಿನಿ್ವಲುಲೋಗಿನುಹ . . . ಹ್ಗೆತ್ರನಿಧಿನಿಕ್ಷೇಪವಲ9 . . . . ವೃಥೋನೇಳಪ್ಪಭೋಗ . . . ಉಬನನ್ನ ಸರ್ವೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಸವಸ್ತ ಭಳಸಿತಮುಗುನ್ನು ಸಿಪ್ರುತದಾಯಾನಿಂದಿಾಗ್ಗಿ ತ್ರೀಸಾಮನ್ನು ಲುಖವಮ್ಯ್ಕಾನವಾಸವಾ ಮುಕ್ತ ಹನಸ್ಯರಮ್ಯ್ಕಾನುಸತ್ಯಪರಿಶೋಧ . ಗಾಸುರ್ಕಯುದಿನಂ10 . . . ಮಿಗ್ಗಾನವಾಲುಯುಗ್ಗಾಮವುಮುಡನಾಚಿನಿವಿನಯುಯಾಕ್ಯ್ವಲುಲ ಭೋಗಮ್ಯ್ಮುಯಿನತುಗಾನಅನುಭವಂ . . . ಅವಾಲುಅತಿನೆಮುಪ್ಪುರuj . . . ವುಂರಂಭೊಯಿಟಿನಕೆಯದಾನವಸತ್ಪರಿಯೊಂಯುರುಕಸಾಹೃಲೋಕತಿಪ್ರದೀಕ್ಷಿಥ . . .11 ಚೋಡು . . . ಹರೋಂತಅಉಳಫಲನಿ . . . ತುಯಾದುಲು . . . ವಿನಬನವರಿದಕ್ಷಿತಲುನಸಂಮತಿಚೇವಿಬಡಿಸಿಂಗ್ರಯುವಾಸಿನದಾನಸಕ್ತಯಪತ್ರಿಯಿಪಾತ್ಕಾಲುಳಿಪ್ಪೆನ್ಯ್ಕಾಲುವಾಲುತಿದಿ . . ನ . . . ರಾಯದುಪ್ಪನವರಹ . . .12ಭಂಡಾರ . . . ಅನುಮತಿಯೊಬರಹನಮುಪ್ಪುರನಮತಿಯರಹಸಸಾಕ್ಷಿಲು, . ವೋಲಳಸೋಮೇವಅಪ್ಪೀರಲಾಸಾಕ್ಷಿ * ಬಲ್.,ಯುಜನಸಂಖ್ಯ

ಅದೋ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ :

13ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಕಳಚರುಷಂಬುಲ ೧೮೪೯ ಅಗುನೇಟು . . .
14 . . . . ಸಂವತ್ಸರದೆಕ್ತಾವಣಿ ಶು ೪ಲು ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ಸಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರ್ರೀವೀರಪ್ರತಾಪ್ರ್ರೀರಾಸ್ರಾಜ್ಯತದೇವರ
ರಾಯಮಮಹಾರಾಯಲುಪಥ್ವೀರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೆಯ್ಯುಂಟುಂಡುಾಗಪೆನುಗೊಂದಸೀಮಲುನೀಲಿಸಿಪೂಕ್ಷಿವಿರೇಕ್ಷ್ಯರಣಿಕಿಅಕ್ಷ್ಯ ತರಾಣ
ಯಮವಲೇಶಣಾ . . .

15 . . . ಭೂದಾನಧರ್ಮಉಳಸನಕಮ್ಯ್ಕಾವನೆತ್ತುಿನನುವನು | ಭಂಡಾರಂಪಲ್ಪುರಸನಕೋಡಉಕಲುತಿಂಮಪ್ಪಗಾರುಪ್ಯ್ಕೊಂಡೆ
ಪರಾ . . . . . . ನುಮವಾಕಕ್ಷ್ಯಯು . . . . . . . . .

16 . . . ಯಶಸನನವ್ಯ್ಕಾನವಿರೂಮಕ್ಷಪುರಮನ . . . ನಡಿಸಿದುರುವುಗ್ಗಾಮುಎಂಲಿವೀರ್ಷಿವಿರೇಕ್ಷ್ರರಿಅಣ್ಯಉತರಾಯಮಮಲ್ಲಪ್ಪಂಗೊ
ಗಾರುಸಹಿರೇಖ್ಯ್ಕಾದದಾನಧಾರಾಪೂರ್ವ ಕಾಂಗಳಸುಯಿ ಮಿಗನಕ . . .

17 . . . ಲೋನಿಸ್ಗೈ ಹಾರಾಮಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ನಿಧಿ ನಿಕ್ಷೇಪಜಲಮವಿ ಪಾಣಾಲ್ಪೀಣಅಗಾಮಸಿದ್ಧ ಸಾಥ್ಸಾಲುಅಚಿನೀಟಅಪ್ಪ್ಯಭೋಗೆತೇಜಸನ್ಯ್ಕಾ
ಲುಂಒನುಸರ್ವೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ನವಮ್ಯ್ಕ ಬೃಳಸಿತಮುಗುನುಲೇವಕ್ಷಿವಿರೇಕ್ಷ್ಯರನಿಕಿಅಮ್ಮತದದಿನ್ಯ್ವೇದರಿವೀರಪಾವಧನ . .
18 . . . . ಅಂಗರಂಗವ್ಯ್ಭವಲಕುಂಗಾನ:ಅಣ್ಣ ತರಾಯಮಲ್ಲಪ್ಪಂಗonaut;ಅನ್ಯಮಿಳಚು ತಪವಹಾಳಾಯಕಪೂಣ್ಯಾಗಾನ : ನು
ದ್ಯೃಪ್ಪಂಜಿ || ಗಾನಉಅಹೋದ್ಗರ್ಾಯಸ್ಥಾಧೀಯ ಗಾನಉನಳಿಕೆ . . . . . . .್ಯಿಡಿಯೊಚ್ಚ್ ಗಗ್ಗಾ) . . .
19 . . . . ದಾನಧರ್ಮ ಕಾಶಸಂಸ್ಮೃರತಾೃಪರದತ್ತಾ ವಾ ವಾಯೋರ್ಜಲೇತಪವಸುಂಧರಾಮ್ || ಷಷ್ಠಿವರ್ಷಸಹಸ್ರಾಣಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗೇವೊದ್ಮ್ಯ್ಕೋಜೆತೇ
ಯಥೇಕ್ರಿಮಿ || ದಾನವನಲನಯೇಮದ್ಭ್ಯೋ ದ್ಯ್ಕಾಲಥ್ಯೋಯೇಷ್ಠಪಾಲನಂ | ದಾನನ್ಯ್ಮಗ್ಗಾವವಾಪ್ಯ್ಕತ್ರೀಚುವಾಲನಾದಹ್ಯ್ಕ
20ತಂಪದಂ || ಯಿದಧರ್ಮಶಾಸನಮುಯಿಚ್ಚಿ ನಲಚುತೃರಾಯಮಲ್ಲಪ್ಪಣಗಾರಿಕಿ . ಮಂಗಲಮಹಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ

text.text_original: ಅದೋ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ :13ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಕಳಚರುಷಂಬುಲ ೧೮೪೯ ಅಗುನೇಟು . . .14 . . . . ಸಂವತ್ಸರದೆಕ್ತಾವಣಿ ಶು ೪ಲು ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ಸಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರ್ರೀವೀರಪ್ರತಾಪ್ರ್ರೀರಾಸ್ರಾಜ್ಯತದೇವರರಾಯಮಮಹಾರಾಯಲುಪಥ್ವೀರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೆಯ್ಯುಂಟುಂಡುಾಗಪೆನುಗೊಂದಸೀಮಲುನೀಲಿಸಿಪೂಕ್ಷಿವಿರೇಕ್ಷ್ಯರಣಿಕಿಅಕ್ಷ್ಯ ತರಾಣಯಮವಲೇಶಣಾ . . .15 . . . ಭೂದಾನಧರ್ಮಉಳಸನಕಮ್ಯ್ಕಾವನೆತ್ತುಿನನುವನು | ಭಂಡಾರಂಪಲ್ಪುರಸನಕೋಡಉಕಲುತಿಂಮಪ್ಪಗಾರುಪ್ಯ್ಕೊಂಡೆಪರಾ . . . . . . ನುಮವಾಕಕ್ಷ್ಯಯು . . . . . . . . .16 . . . ಯಶಸನನವ್ಯ್ಕಾನವಿರೂಮಕ್ಷಪುರಮನ . . . ನಡಿಸಿದುರುವುಗ್ಗಾಮುಎಂಲಿವೀರ್ಷಿವಿರೇಕ್ಷ್ರರಿಅಣ್ಯಉತರಾಯಮಮಲ್ಲಪ್ಪಂಗೊಗಾರುಸಹಿರೇಖ್ಯ್ಕಾದದಾನಧಾರಾಪೂರ್ವ ಕಾಂಗಳಸುಯಿ ಮಿಗನಕ . . .17 . . . ಲೋನಿಸ್ಗೈ ಹಾರಾಮಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ನಿಧಿ ನಿಕ್ಷೇಪಜಲಮವಿ ಪಾಣಾಲ್ಪೀಣಅಗಾಮಸಿದ್ಧ ಸಾಥ್ಸಾಲುಅಚಿನೀಟಅಪ್ಪ್ಯಭೋಗೆತೇಜಸನ್ಯ್ಕಾಲುಂಒನುಸರ್ವೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ನವಮ್ಯ್ಕ ಬೃಳಸಿತಮುಗುನುಲೇವಕ್ಷಿವಿರೇಕ್ಷ್ಯರನಿಕಿಅಮ್ಮತದದಿನ್ಯ್ವೇದರಿವೀರಪಾವಧನ . .18 . . . . ಅಂಗರಂಗವ್ಯ್ಭವಲಕುಂಗಾನ:ಅಣ್ಣ ತರಾಯಮಲ್ಲಪ್ಪಂಗonaut;ಅನ್ಯಮಿಳಚು ತಪವಹಾಳಾಯಕಪೂಣ್ಯಾಗಾನ : ನುದ್ಯೃಪ್ಪಂಜಿ || ಗಾನಉಅಹೋದ್ಗರ್ಾಯಸ್ಥಾಧೀಯ ಗಾನಉನಳಿಕೆ . . . . . . .್ಯಿಡಿಯೊಚ್ಚ್ ಗಗ್ಗಾ) . . .19 . . . . ದಾನಧರ್ಮ ಕಾಶಸಂಸ್ಮೃರತಾೃಪರದತ್ತಾ ವಾ ವಾಯೋರ್ಜಲೇತಪವಸುಂಧರಾಮ್ || ಷಷ್ಠಿವರ್ಷಸಹಸ್ರಾಣಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗೇವೊದ್ಮ್ಯ್ಕೋಜೆತೇಯಥೇಕ್ರಿಮಿ || ದಾನವನಲನಯೇಮದ್ಭ್ಯೋ ದ್ಯ್ಕಾಲಥ್ಯೋಯೇಷ್ಠಪಾಲನಂ | ದಾನನ್ಯ್ಮಗ್ಗಾವವಾಪ್ಯ್ಕತ್ರೀಚುವಾಲನಾದಹ್ಯ್ಕ20ತಂಪದಂ || ಯಿದಧರ್ಮಶಾಸನಮುಯಿಚ್ಚಿ ನಲಚುತೃರಾಯಮಲ್ಲಪ್ಪಣಗಾರಿಕಿ . ಮಂಗಲಮಹಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ6-8ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಹಳ್ಳಗಡ್ಡಿ ಹೋಡಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಕಲ್ಲಗಳು.ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6' × 4'.ಗ್ರಂಥ ಮತ್ತು ಅರಕ್ಷರ.* ದೇವನಾಗಾರ್‌.Stones planted in the Hallagaddi hole of the same village.Dimensions 6' × 4'.Text and characters.* Devanagār.[Footnote 1] * ದೇವನಾಗಾರ್.

Taśari-ppanman Kâttaman of the Kûḍal Twelve in Irumaḍi-nâḍu included in Râjēndra-Sôḷa-vaḷa-nâḍu, *alias* . . . . . . of Sôḷa-maṇḍalam, made a grant of certain lands (specified) which he had received as a *kuḍangai* from Irumaḍi-Sôḷa-râjar, the chief of the Irumaḍi-nâḍu Three- hundred, for having constructed a tank and built a sluice in Taśari in which he was a landholder, as well as of certain other lands (specified), for the god Mahâdēvar of the village. cells.remarks: (Telugu)— Be it well. (On the date specified), the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara râjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara vīra-Bukka-mahârâja’s daughter Virûpâ-Dêvi’s daughter Jommâ-Dêvi directed a channel to be made in front of Tirumaṇi village belonging to Kârakuṛiki-sthala in the Penugoṇḍa kingdom,— and sending for her minister Bomma-râja’s son Nâga-râja, and her great uncle’s son Mâyi-Nâyini,— and saying to them ‘You must make this channel’, — they sent for the late Vôja’s sons Peḍa-Bayira-Vôja and Pina-Bayira-Vôja, and gave them the contract. And they dug a channel from before Peda-Nandisiriyûru and carrying it on below, led it so as to fill the tank. And they agreed for 130 Siṅgaya gadyâṇa, and certain land (specified) at the sluice, a horse and bracelets, — on condition that these should be returned if water did not flow in the channel from Annadânamuchadi to Immaḍiyûru. And having performed the proper ceremonies, they caused the water to flow in the channel, on which the above gifts were given to them, and also a dasavanda, free of all imposts, under the Tirumaṇi tank. *(Rest illegible.)*

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ತಿರುಮಣಿ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಕೆರೆಗೆ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಡೆನುಗಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿದ್ದಿರುವ ಕಲ್ಲು.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 3' × 3'.

^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕವರುಷಂಭು
^2ಲ ೧೪೯೧° ಅಗುನೆಟಿಧಾತುಸಂವತ್ಸರಮಾಸಕು ೨ ಲೂ
3ಶ್ರೀವನ್ನ ಹಂಮೂದಳೇತ್ಯರರಾಜರಾಜರಾಜರಮೆವೇ
^4ಕ್ಕೃಕ್ರೀವಿರಮುಕ್ತ ಮಹಾರಾಯಕುವರ್ಮತಿವಿರೂಮದೇವಿಕ್ಷು
^5ವತಾತೀಜೋರ್ನಾವದೇವಿನಿಗೊಂಡರಾಜ್ಯಮುದುಕಾರಕಉಟ್ಟುಕಿತ್ತ್ ಮುಲೊತೆಯಿ
^6ರುಜನ್ನುಅತಿರುಮಣಿಮೂಂದುವದೀಮ್ಯುಮಡುಕಾಳವಕಪ್ಪನಯ್ಯ್ಯ
^7ಗಿಂಚಿತಮಪ್ರದಾ;ಸೇ.ಬೊಮರಾಜಕೊಂಡುಶನಾಗರಾಜಣುತವಹಿಗದನಾ
^8ಯಿನಾಯಿನಿಕೋಡಕುವಾಯಿನುಯಿಂಗಿರಿವಿರನಂಚಿನೆಚಿಟಿಮಿರಲ . . .
^9ವತವಿಂಪ್ವಮನಗಾಸುವಾರೂತೊಲಿಕೆಸೇಜಕೂಳಚುಕುಲಪಿದಮೆಯಿರೆ . .
^10ನುಬಿನಪಬಯಿರಪೊರ್ಜಾಚುನಿಪಲ.ಪಿಂಚಿವಾರಿಶಕಾಲುವಗುತ್ತಗಾನೀಜನ . . .
^11ಮುಖಿಪದನಂದಿಸರಿಯೂರುಮುಂದೆಟಿನಕಿಡಿಗುವಣೆಗೀರವಾತ್ಸೆನ್ . . .
^12ಕಾಲವದವಿನಿದೇಚುಜುವಿಕುಪಕರವನುಂಗಲುಗಲ್ ೧೪೦ ಮಾಡ . .
^13ಸಿಂಗಯತೊಮುವನದಮುವಮುಟಿಗಿ೧೬ಉಮ್ಮುನು೧೭ಡ .
^14ಸಕಟಾಯಲುವನಪಿಖಿವಾರಮಮುದಬೀಔಪುಕ್ತುವರಪರಿಕಣದ . .

^17ಸಿಮಿಅದಸವರದಮೂಸಿಗೆಯಸಂದಾಮುಮುಕ್ಕ್ರೀರುಮಣಿಯುರೊಮೂಂ . .
^18ಕೀಳಿಟೊಯುವನೇಕಪಿಡಿಶಿಮಿゆうಮತ್ತುಖತಿವಿನಿಳಕಾವಿಮುಂನು . . .

text.location: At Tirumaṇi (Guḍabaṇḍi hobli), on a stone in the place called Naḍamagaḍḍe.
text.remarks:
(Telugu)— Be it well. (On the date specified), the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara
râjâdhirâja râja-paramêśvara vīra-Bukka-mahârâja’s daughter Virûpâ-Dêvi’s
daughter Jommâ-Dêvi directed a channel to be made in front of Tirumaṇi
village belonging to Kârakuṛiki-sthala in the Penugoṇḍa kingdom,— and
sending for her minister Bomma-râja’s son Nâga-râja, and her great uncle’s
son Mâyi-Nâyini,— and saying to them ‘You must make this channel’, — they
sent for the late Vôja’s sons Peḍa-Bayira-Vôja and Pina-Bayira-Vôja, and gave
them the contract. And they dug a channel from before Peda-Nandisiriyûru
and carrying it on below, led it so as to fill the tank. And they agreed for
130 Siṅgaya gadyâṇa, and certain land (specified) at the sluice, a horse and
bracelets, — on condition that these should be returned if water did not flow
in the channel from Annadânamuchadi to Immaḍiyûru. And having performed
the proper ceremonies, they caused the water to flow in the channel, on which
the above gifts were given to them, and also a dasavanda, free of all imposts,
under the Tirumaṇi tank. *(Rest illegible.)*

...
² ...to Tirumalalnatha... in the place called... Anantavarshiruma[l]deva... stone temple... grant of dharma shasana...

ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿಕ್ರತೃರುವೇಂಗಳನಾಥವೆವರಗಸ್ತಿಂ ದ್ಯುಯಲತಪ್ಪದದನಂಗಣಗಳಸೌಂಮಗಡಿದದತರವಮಲನಾರಧೂವರಾಜಪುವಕಾರ್ವಾಣಕೋಟ್ಯು² ಧ್ರುವಾ೯ ಶನವದಕ್ಕಮವೇತದೇರಿತುವುಂಗಳನಾಥದೇವರಿಗೆವೇಪ್ರಜಾರುಏನವಮಾದಿಕೊಂಡುಶ್ರೀಸದ್ವ್ಯಾಕಳದಲೂಮಂತ್ರಪ್ರಪ್ಪವನ್ನೀಕ್ಕಿಕೊಂಡುತುರುಮಲದೇವರೆವರಸಂಧಿಯಿಲ್ಲದುರುಮಲಪುರದೆವರುಗಳು ಹರವೆಕಟ್ಕೊಂಡುಯುಹಂಥಾದೇವಬ್ರಂಹಳೀಕೊಟಯುತಿಶ್ರೀಗಳವಿವರಗdidದವಮುಲಸನ್ಯ ಸದೋಸೇಮುಯದೇವರಿಗೆ ಬಿಂದಿತವಾಗಿದೇಮಣುನಿಯಮುಂಗುಳಗದಹೋಲುಸಮುಗಃಶ್ರೀಕೇರಲುವರಗಸನಫದೇ(ವರೀಕರಿಅಯುಕೆವಿ)ಸ್ತಿಂ ವರದಂಜಾದೇವಳಮುತ್ತಪದಗಿಪಿೃತ್ತಿಂ ಕಾಸ್ಮ್ಯಾಗ್ರೇತದವಲುಮಾಯಂ³ಲಿಂಗಹಮಕ ಉತ್ಸಿಗೆಆಲಯ್ಯಗಿಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಕಾಸ್ಮ್ಯಾಗೋತ್ರದವೇಸಿಣಗರಗಳಮಕ್ಕ ಳಉರಾದ್ಧದೇವರಗಳಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಆಕಾಸ್ನ್ಯಪಾರೋತ್ರದವರಾಧ್ವದೇವಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳ.ಉರಲ್ವಣಿಸಂಗಣಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಗೋತ್ರದವರಾಧ್ವದೇವರಗಳಮಕ್ಕ ಳಉಜ್ಯೋತ್ರಿಧ್ವಸ್ತಂಗಣಘಟಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಗೋತ್ರದವರಾಧ್ವದೇವರಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉವರಂಗಣಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಕಾಸ್ಮ್ಯಾಗೋತ್ರದವರಾಧ್ವಭರರವಮಕ್ಕ ಳಉಅನಂತಭಟಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಕಾಸ್ಮ್ಯಾಗೋತ್ರದಭಾವಣಂಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಮರ್ಕೇಸವಣಗಳಿಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಹರಿಕೋಟಗೋತ್ರದಚ್ಉದಾಧರಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉಜನನಘಣಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಶ್ರೀವತ್ಸಗೋ⁴ತ್ಗದಂಗಣಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಸೋಮೇವಣಗಳಿಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ವಲಂದ ಗ್ಗೋತ್ರದಲಬಾಳಮಗದೇವಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ವಸಿಷ್ಠಗೋತ್ರದಅಲಜಣಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಪವದರಘಣಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಜಾಮವದ್ಗಾತ್ರದವೃತ್ತ ಗೋತ್ರದಉದಹದೇವಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಲಂಗಣಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಶಾಂಡಿಲ್ಯಗೋತ್ರದವೆದೇವಣಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಶವರಮಾಳೀಚೇವಣಗಳಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಶಾಂಡಿಲ್ಯಗೋತ್ರದವೇದೇವಣಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಸಂಗಣಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಕಳುಕಟಗೋತ್ರದಳಉದಹದೇವಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉತಿರುಮಲನಾಥಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಶಾಂಡಿಲ್ಯಗೋತ್ರದಅಉಬಲಬರುರುವಗಣಗರಹಗೆವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಕಾಶ್ಯಪಗೋತ್ರದವೇಮಪ್ಪವರು⁵ ರಮಕ್ಕ ಳಉಕಚಣಂಗಣಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಗೋತ್ರದವನಂಜಣಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಅತ್ಯಂವಣಂಗೇವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಭರದ್ವಾಜಗೋೇತ್ರದವಲಿಜಣಗಳಮಕ್ಕಳಉಪವಜ್ಯಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಅನ್ಸುವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಂ ಅಕ್ಷರದರುಣವಿಪ್ತ್ರೀ ಯುಪತನದರಕೇತ್ವಕ್ಷೇತದವಿದರನಮಗನುಲವದಿದದಗಣಾಮವದವೇಳಗಳಂಗಣಮವಳಕಲುಅಂಕುಟೀವೇಕಳಿಗಂತಲುವಕಾರ್ಯಕಂಟುಉಪುರದು | ಅಕಾಂಟಯುದರಕೇನಲುವಜತಸ್ಸಿವಿಜೀವವರ⁶ ವೂಡಲಡೆಯುಂ ... ವೆಲಂತಕಲುಮುಯಳಗಂದೆನಗಹೋಡಹರಿಸಮೇಲೆಪಡುವಲು, ಹಿಂಡಿಯುತೋಳುಹೋಗಾಬೆಟ್ಡುಲಳೋಜೆಯುವೆರೆ | ಬಡಗಳೂರುಕಲ್ಲಬಲ್ಲಿಯಬುದಜಬಂಜೆಮೆಳ್ಳೆಯಜುಸುತ್ತಮಯುವುಳಗಳಅನಿಕ್ಕೇಪ್ರಜಲವಿಶಾಸನಾಂಶಗಳಿಗೆಮಿಸದೃಶ್ಯಮುತ್ತುವದಅಷ್ಟಭೋಗತೇಜಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯವನುಸ್ತೇಪ್ರತ್ಯಜ್ಞಾನಿಸಾವಂತದಾಯಾದ್ನುಮತವಗಿತ್ಯ್ಕಂ7 ರಣಕುಧವಗೀತೇಧ್ವಂಸಣ್ಮೂಯಾಧಿಕೋಟೇಲು [ ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ ದ್ವಿಗುಣಂಪಣ್ಯಂ ಪರದತ್ತಾ ಸುಪಾಲನಂ |ಪರದಾರೇಷ್ಮಸ್ಯದತ್ತಂ ನಿಷ್ಪಲಂಭವೇತ್ಃ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಂ ಪರದತ್ತಾಂ ವಾ ಯೋರೇಹೇತರತಸುಂವರಾಂಷ್ಯಾತ್ವರುಷಸಹಸ್ರಾಣಿವಿಷ್ಮ್ಯಾಂ ಯಾಣಜಾಯತೇಕೃಮಿ॥ ಯೋಃಕೃಧವಗಿನೀಲೋಕೇಗೇವೇಶಾಮೇವಭೂಷಾಣಂಭೂಜಾನ್ಯಕರಾಗ್ಯಾವಿಪುದತಾ ವಸುಂಧರಾ || ಯಿಧಮಾಽಕ್ಕೆ ಅರುತಪ್ಪಿದರಲುಂಗದಯುಲಯಿಕಫಲೀಯುಕೊಂಡಪಪದಲಿಹೋಪರು8ಮಂಗಳ9ಮಹಶ್ರೀ10ಶ್ರೀಶ್ರೀಶಾಸನಾಂಶಗಳಿಗೆಮಿಸದೃಶ್ಯಮುತ್ತುವದಅಷ್ಟಭೋಗತೇಜಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯವನುಸ್ತೇಪ್ರತ್ಯಜ್ಞಾನಿಸಾವಂತದಾಯಾದ್ನುಮತವಗಿತ್ಯ್ಕಂ7 ರಣಕುಧವಗೀತೇಧ್ವಂಸಣ್ಮೂಯಾಧಿಕೋಟೇಲು [ ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ ದ್ವಿಗುಣಂಪಣ್ಯಂ ಪರದತ್ತಾ ಸುಪಾಲನಂ |ಪರದಾರೇಷ್ಮಸ್ಯದತ್ತಂ ನಿಷ್ಪಲಂಭವೇತ್ಃ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಂ ಪರದತ್ತಾಂ ವಾ ಯೋರೇಹೇತರತಸುಂವರಾಂಷ್ಯಾತ್ವರುಷಸಹಸ್ರಾಣಿವಿಷ್ಮ್ಯಾಂ ಯಾಣಜಾಯತೇಕೃಮಿ॥ ಯೋಃಕೃಧವಗಿನೀಲೋಕೇಗೇವೇಶಾಮೇವಭೂಷಾಣಂಭೂಜಾನ್ಯಕರಾಗ್ಯಾವಿಪುದತಾ ವಸುಂಧರಾ || ಯಿಧಮಾಽಕ್ಕೆ ಅರುತಪ್ಪಿದರಲುಂಗದಯುಲಯಿಕಫಲೀಯುಕೊಂಡಪಪದಲಿಹೋಪರು8ಮಂಗಳ9ಮಹಶ್ರೀ10ಶ್ರೀಶ್ರೀ[Translation not applicable to this primary-source inscription text block, rendered literally as instructed].

3ಪೃತಿಸವಂತರಾಜಾಳನಸರ್ಕೃತುಸೋಮ್ಯ

5 ..... ಶ್ರೀತಿರುವೆಂಗಳನಾಥ

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಬಾಲಿರೆಡ್ಡಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ವ ಗುರಂಮನುಕರೇ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕೋಣೀಬಳ ಗುಡ್ಡದಲ್ಲಿ
ಹುಟ್ಟು ಗುಂದಿನ ಮೇಲೆ.
ತೆಲುಗು.

^ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕವರ್ಷಂಬುಲು
^ಲು ೧೬೫೪ ಅಗುನೇಟಿಲನಾಮವಂಸಂ | ವಗ್ಗಶೇರ ಬ ೫ ಸ್ಥಿರ
^ವಸರಮದುಪ್ರೇಮನ್ನ ನಾಯಕಾಚಾಬಾಜ್ಯೋತ್ಪಲ್ಯ್ಪನಗುರಂಮ್ಯನಾ
^ಯುನಕದರೆಪ್ಪನಾಯುನಾಸಿರಾಪೇರಡನಾಯನಿಗಾರೂಲಯು
^ಮಂಟುಪನಕುಮಾರೂಡುವೆಂಕಟಪತಿಶಿನ್ಯಾಯುಂಚೆರಿಯೊಚ್ಚಿ
^ನಾಸಾತನತಟುಕಾನಿಮಾನಿರಣಿರ್ಯಾತಿಲಶಾಶನವನ್ನಾನಾ
^ಯುಂಕೋಣಕಸಕಲೂರ್ಪಲ್ಪಿನಮುಲಗದ್ದಲೊಂಟೆಸಿಲೊಲಿದ್ದಿಪಲ್ಲ್ಯ
^ಕಳೇ^ನೆವಿನನುಗಾಚಾರುವುಕಟ್ಟಿ^ಣಿನಾವನುಗನಶೌಯಾಚೇ
^ರಪ್ರಕೀದೆಅಜಟ್ಟು ಕಟ್ಟುಪ್ರತಿಕರಮೂಡಿಯುನಿವಾರರಾಜ್ಯಂಪಡದು
^ಸಾಲಲು, ಹೋಲಪದ್ಮವೃತ್ತಾಂತೇನಭವಭುಕ್ಯ್ಯಗಾನಡಿಮಿಪಳೇಗಲವರಮು
^ಪಿಂಮಟನಾಗಚರಿಸಗಂವಿ^ಕೂಕುಸಗಂಯೊಪಕಾರಕಾರಣ್ಯತ್ಥಮೂಗಾನಡಿ
^ಪಿಸ್ಟಾ.ಮುನಾಯಿಯಿನಪುತ್ರತ್ರಪತ್ರಪಾರಂಪಯ್ಯ^ಂತಠರಅನುಭವವಂಶಕೂ
^ನ್ನಿಸುಖಾನವಪುಂಜೆಡಿಯೊಬಾಲಿರೆಡ್ಡಿ ಸ್ಥಳ ಗಲ್ಲರೆಡ್ಡಿ ಕಕ್ಕ ನ್ನಕೂನೂ
^ತತನಮೂಗಾನಿಕೂಪ^ಕೋಟೆಯಿಒಚ್ಚಿ, ನಾರಂಗಾಪುವುಯೆಂದುಕಾವನ್ನಾಜೇ
^ನುಸಕಲವಿಚ್ಚಿ ನಾಮಮಕೃಪೀತಮಮುಗಾನಉಭಂಎಟಿಕೆಯೆಂಚೆ :ಸುತ
^ಜಿಸ್ಸಿನೇರಸಿಂಹಸನ್ನಾಮಿ, . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
^ದಮರ್ತುಅನಿವ್ರಿಯಿಂಟಿಯಿಒಚ್ಚಿ^ನಶಿಳಾಶಾಸನಮು

Hail, prosperity! In the victorious and prosperous Salivahana Saka year
1654, corresponding to the [cyclic] year Nāmavaṁśa: at Vaggaśēra, on the 5th day of the bright fortnight, being stable: Varamaduprēmanna, the chieftain ..., along with Gurammanyana andayakan Kadareppanayuna, Sirapēraḍanāyanigāru, ... and his son Venkatapati-śi[r]nāyu, coming and establishing a permanent sthāna-śāsana (charter of foundation)... at Kōnakasalūrpallina, ... constructing an irrigation dam and causing it to yield growth, protecting it with prowess, preventing distress in the kingdom...
For years, the grants of land... [Here follows details of gifts, boundaries, and witnesses, invoking the protection of Narasimha]. This is the stone inscription.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕುಂಟೂರು ರಪ್ಪನ ಗವೀರ್ಗಳ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಗುಂಡಿನ ಮೇಲೆ.

In the same hobli, on the huttu-gundi (anthill pit) of the cave of Kunturu Rappa.

^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕರುಷು೧೫೩೯ ತರಣಸಂವತ್ಸರಶ್ರವಣಬಂಗಳು॥
^2ಶ್ರೀಮತುಬಾಗೇಪಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಳಲಂಕಮರಂಗಂಪಬಾಲವಂಕ್ತಕುವಾರಹೂಕುಂಟೊಲ್ಲರಪ್ಪಗಾಕಿಯ್ಯಾಂಸಳ೨ರು ಕರಣುಸನಹ
^3ಯುಚ್ಚಿ ನದಾನಪತ್ರಕ್ರಮುಮೆವೊಂನೆನು। ಯುಗಾದಿದಮುಕೊಂಡೊಳರಗಿನಗಟ್ಟಂಚಿನಗಿನಲೊಣ್ಯಾಕ್ಷರಪತಿಷ್ಟಳೇಯಿಂಒಕ್ಷ್ಮೈ
^4ಹೂಯುತಿವೆನಾಂತರವೆಂಯಿಂಖ್ಯು ಕೊನಿ...ಕೊನಿಪುಂಖ್ಯ್...............................................
^5ಹೂಬಳಿಳವತ್ವೆನ್ಯಬೂಗೆಪಳ್ಳೆ ಚರುಪುಕೊಧ್ಯ ನುಲಅಚ್ಚ ಕಟ್ಟುಮಡಿಲೊಂದಿರ್ದ ವಾರಿ .....................
(ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ)

cells.remarks: (Telugu)—For the daily and seasonal festivals, the support of the *archaka*, and all other requirements of the master of myriads of worlds, the god Parusha Veṅkaṭēśvara,—Be it well. (On the date specified), to—devoted to yajana and the six rites, of the Parāśara-gōtra Bōdhāyana-sūtra and Yajuś- śākhā, proficient in the Pañcharātrāgama-śāstra, Tiruchānūr Tiruvenkaḷa- chārya's grandson, Râmâchârya's son, Krishṇamâchârya,—the mahā-nāyakā- chârya, purifier of the Achyuta-gôtra, of the Nârâyaṇa-sûtra and Dhanuś- śākhā, Gummi-Nâyini Timmi-Nâyini's grandson, Kadirappa-Nâyini's son, Nârasimha-Nâyini,—granted the Pôtuladoḍdi village, in the Guyalûr-sthala belonging to our Nâyakship, with all rights,—and also the land formerly belonging to it below the Moraṭupalli tank,—as a sarvamânya,—obtaining orders also from the Râṇuvâri (? army officer) on Râmanidurga for the writing of this śâsana. (signed) śrī-Nârasimha.

cells.remarks: Be it well. .... of all worlds, self-contained heroes, ..... the earth and the sky, making ... the sun and the moon, wearing the constellations as a garland, the falling thunderbolt they catch like a ball, the seven oceans they step over, the mountain chains they leap over, epidemics they fight with so as not to come, Java (Yama)'s panting they ..., death they seize, the head of ... they turn, the attendants of Kulika they pursue after, simple terrors to all the world, having the form of Rudra, like Nandi and Mahâkâla, or Vîrabhadra and the other pramatha gaṇas, having their heads at the feet of the faithful, having their heads .... pure warriors, cutters down of enemies, gainers of intelligence, like vira-bratis they bathe in the ocean borne up by the serpent- adorned (Śiva), run-away cattle they trace, surround themselves with garlands of entrails ........ they worship with their heads cut off, they play on their arms as on the vine, like Râvaṇas of the Kali-yuga, ......., -- praising the feet of these innumerable gaṇas, devoted to works of merit, (was)—Be it well. The great minister sarvâdhikâri, mahâ-pasâyita, supreme favourite, Laṅkara ..... Hiriya Laṅkara .... paṭṭa-sâhani, Irugôṇa-Dêva's karakâru (with other epithets) ....

cells.remarks: (Telugu)—Be it well. (On the date specified), for the supreme lord of the fourteen worlds, treasury of the ocean of love, master of a myriad worlds, chief god of gods, Mâragânikuṇṭa Tiruvengalanâtha,—when the mahârâjâdhi- rāja rāja-paramêśvara vira-pratâpa Achyuta-Dêva-mahârâya was ruling the kingdom of the world:—Bhāṇḍâram Aparasaya's sons Timmarasayya and Koṇḍappayya made a grant of Mâragânikuṇṭa, with its hamlets, in the Guyyalûr-śīme attached to Penugonda belonging to their Nâyakship,—in order that merit might be to Achyuta-Dêva-mahârâya. Grant repeated three times. Imprecations.

text.remarks:
(Telugu)—Be it well. (On the date specified), for the supreme lord of
the fourteen worlds, treasury of the ocean of love, master of a myriad worlds,
chief god of gods, Mâragânikuṇṭa Tiruvengalanâtha,—when the mahârâjâdhi-
rāja rāja-paramêśvara vira-pratâpa Achyuta-Dêva-mahârâya was ruling the
kingdom of the world:—Bhāṇḍâram Aparasaya's sons Timmarasayya and
Koṇḍappayya made a grant of Mâragânikuṇṭa, with its hamlets, in the
Guyyalûr-śīme attached to Penugonda belonging to their Nâyakship,—in
order that merit might be to Achyuta-Dêva-mahârâya. Grant repeated three
times. Imprecations.

cells.location: At Bestarahalli (Billur hobli), copy of a copper inscription.*
cells.dynasty: Vijayanagara
cells.king: Hariharēśvara
cells.language: Sanskrit and Telugu
cells.remarks: Obeisance to Gaṇādhipati. Praises of Śiva, Gaṇēśa, Varāha and Sarasvatī. Usual account of the descent of Yadu from the moon. In his line were many kings, among whom was Bukka, whose wife was Magāmbikā. From them (omitting laudations) was born Saṅgama, whose wife was Mānāmbikā, and they had five sons,— Harihara, Kampa, Bukka, Māra, and Mudda. The eldest of these became the ruler of the nine continents. Having conquered in all points of the compass, he was served by the kings of Aṅga Kaliṅga and other countries. And he ruled in Kuñjarakōṇa-puri (Ānegundi). On one occasion he crossed the Tuṅgabhadrā with the intention of hunting, and coming forth with his army, saw the forests to the south. And in the forest, that moon to the ocean Saṅgamēśa was surprised to see a fierce dog with long teeth, only chewing what had been bitten, and a hare. And seeing the god Virūpāksha along with the goddess Pampā, he did obeisance to them; and drawing near, paid respect to Vidyāraṇya, the yati in that temple, and informed him of the above very curious circumstance. The yatīndra, acquainted with the three times (past, present and future), smiled and said,—“O king, this place is worthy to be the residence of a family of great kings; this is a specially strong site. Make here a city named Vidyā, equal to Alaka (Kubēra's city), with nine gates, wherein you may reside, like Purandara, in wealth acquired by victory in war on all sides, and hold the world in your serpent-like arms.” Thereupon Hariharēśvara, according to his direction, was seated on the throne, adorned with the white umbrella, and made the sixteen great gifts, resplendent in the nagara (or city) called Vidyā (or Vidyānagara) of vast dimensions. (On the date specified), during the *phalābhiṣhēka* festival for Pampā-Virū- pāksha-Mahēśvara, he formed certain agrahāras. And (with praises) to Are- kere Bhāskara's son Pampāvirūpāksha, he gave Yāraguḍi in Tummadāmala, la in the Koṇḍakamala Vallūr-śīme, in the Yakuri-nivṛtti belonging to the Ghanaśaila-puri kingdom. Its boundaries. And he gave it the new name of Vidyāraṇyapura. And for the worship of the god Mahēśvara of Śrīśaila he granted Chiravārapalli. By order of the king the śāsana was engraved by the śāsanāchārya Nāga-dēva. Boundaries in the language of the country (Telugu). Usual final impre- catory verses. (signed) Śrī-Virūpāksha. Bagepalli Talug. Footnote 1. From its date this inscription would be of special interest, if authentic, but it cannot be depended on, being printed from a hand-copy supplied by the people, no original being forthcoming. ^3ಹರೇರ್ಲೀಲಾವರಾಹಸ್ಯದಂಷ್ಟ್ರಾಂಡೋದ್ದತ್ವತ್ಪಾತನಹೇಮಾದ್ರಿ
^4ಶಿರಾಯತಧರಾತ್ರೆತ್ರೈತ್ರಿತ್ರಯಂದಧಾ || ^5 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕ
^6ದ್ಬಾಂಬುಲ ಒ೬೬೬ ಅಗುನನೆತಿಶ್ರೇಮುಖನಾಮಸಂ ॥ ^7 ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠ ಶುದ್ಧ ೧೬ ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ಸ್ಯಮಹಾಘನವಿನಾಡಪ್ರಭು
^8ಲ್ಯ್ನಪಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜವನ್ನಿರೇಗಣಿನವರಿಸುತ್ಯ್ನಮನ್ನುದ್ಯನಾರಾಯಣಸ್ವಾಮಿವಿಪ್ರಪುತ್ರಲ್ಯ್ನರಂಗಪ್ಪ
^9ಯ್ಯ್ನಗಪುನಿನವಾರಣ್ವೇಮುಅಭಸಂಘಸೂತ್ರಲ್ಯ್ನಯಜುಶಾಖಾಧ್ಯಾಮ್ಯುಲಕ್ಯ್ನಕರ್ಣಸಗೋತ್ರೋ
^10ದ್ಬ ವೃಲ್ಲೃತಸಂಬಂಧಯ್ಯ್ನಗರಿಂಘಪತ್ಯಲ್ಯ್ನವೇಂಕಟಪತಯ್ಯ್ನಗಾಪುತ್ಯಲ್ಯ್ನವೇಂಕಲಮ್ಮಯ್ಯ್ನಗಾರನೆಮಾಂ
^11ಕುಮ್ಯ್ನಯೊಂಕಿಟ್ಯ್ನತಬ್ಧಅಧಿಪಾಧನಮಹಾಶಾಸನಮುನ್ನುವಕ್ಕಟೊನ್ನನವಾಬಾರುಮಿದಮುಲನುಂ
^12೧೬ ಮಂಮುವನುಅಶ್ರಿಯೊಂಚಿಅಂನಸ್ತಿ ಥಾಅದಸೆಚಿಪ್ಪ್ಯ್ನಕುಂಟುಪೊಂಟಿಂಗನಕಅದೇಪ್ರಕಾ
^13ರಂಗಾನವಾಕುಪುತ್ರೊತ್ಸಕಾಲಮಂದು ಅನೇಕಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣುಲಕುಪದಕಮಹಾಧಾನಾ
^14ಲುಚೇಕಾಲಮವಂದುವಿಚಾರಣ್ಣಪಕಾಚೇ ಕಳಿನವರುದವಯುಖುನಿವತ್ತೈಥುಡುಗಾನ
^15ಕುಪುತ್ರಿನಾಮವ್ಯ್ನವನಾಯಿತಿ ಕಡುಗಾನಕುನುಕಳ್ಳಿ ದಿಕಸಮವಹಾರಾಗಾಣಿಕುಂಟಿ ವ್ಳತ
^16ಮ್ಯ್ನಮಮಜರಾಹೇಂರಂಪಲ್ಲೆ ಗೋತ್ರತಿಪೇಟ್ರಪೂಲಮುಅಳುನಪಕಟುಯಿಕೆಂದ
^17ನೀರಾರಂಭಂಒಮಿ ಯುಷ್ಯ್ನಲೊಂಟುಪೊಂಟಿಚಂತತೆಪೇಸನಹಾಮವ್ಯ್ನದಾನಾಜಕತಿಸುಕೊನಿ
^18ನೀಲಟಿಹಂಸೊನಪಲ್ಲೆ ವಿಕಾಸಸಿಹರಿಯೊಕ್ಕೇದಾನಧಾರಪೂಪವರ್ಷಕಾಂಗಮಾವ್ಯ್ನ
^19ಪ್ಪದೈನೆತಪ್ಪಿತ್ಯ್ನಗಾಯ್ಚ್ಟೆನಾರಮಮುನು ಕಾಯಿನಪಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಜ್ಚಳ್ಳ ಭೋಮಿತೂಪೂತ
^20ತ್ಮುಕ್ಕುವಚೆಪ್ಪಿಕುಂಟಲೊ ನಿಲ್ಲವ್ಯ್ನಾಗಣಹದಧದ್ರಕ್ಟಣಕೊಟ್ಟು ಕುಂಜಾಲಪಲ್ಲೆ ಪೂ
^21ಲ್ಲನೆರಹದಧು ರಕ್ಷೆ ಮಂಡಟ್ಟು ಕುಮಾದವ್ಯ್ನಪಾರಿಪಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂಲಿಮಿರಹದಧ್ರುತ್ರಂ
^22ಕಟ್ಟುಕುಬಲ್ಲೆ ಪಲ್ಲೆ ಪೂಲಿಮಿರಲೊಂಬಹದಧ್ಯುಮಾವ್ಯ್ನ್ಯತೆಕಾಣರಹ
^23ಣ್ಣಿಕಾರಣರಭ
^24೧೬ ೧೭ ರಣರಭುಲೊಂನಿಧಿಕ್ಷೇಪಜಲತರು ಮಹಾಪಾಣಾಶ್ವೀಣಅಗಾಮಿಮುಖ್ಯಸದೃ
^25ಮುಅಲನೆಅಷ್ಟಭೋಗೇಗಣ್ಯವ್ಯ್ಮುಲನುಅನುಭವಿಸುಂಚಿಕೊಣುವಿರಾದುವಿನಾಃ
^26ಸಕುಅಜ್ಜ ವಳಿನಜೋಣಿಆದಿನಿ ಗಿ ೧೦ಲಿಂ ಆಕ್ರಾಲನವಿದಿವದವರಹಲುರೊಕಾಧಿ
^27ವಾಣಾನಕಅಜ್ಜು ಕೊನ್ನಿನಿವಾಪುತೃತ್ಸಪರಂಪರಗಾಂಪಲ್ಲೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸುಂಕೊನಿ
^28ಸುಖುನವಂದೇ || ನರಿಕಕಣಿಕತ್ಮುಂಟುಣಿವಾನಿಷ ರಷಜೆಕಿಶನಪುರ್ವಕಂ
^29ಗಾಮ್ಯ್ಚಿ ನಾರಮುಮುಗನುಕವಿದುರ್ಗಂತಲಾಳಕಾಲತವಾನಕೊಚಾಟಾರಂಒಂ
^30ಕೃ ಸೌಲೆಲ್ಯ್ಲು ಲಸಹಾwನ್ಯಸುಕೋಸಿವಿಗಂಚೆಣವುರ್ವೆದಿನಿಯ್ನಾಯೊಂಚಿ ಯು
^31ಚೆಟ್ಟಿ ನಭೂಮಿನಾಧಮೂ ಕಾಲನವ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಂದಿಗುಣಾಂಪುಣ್ಯಂಪರದತ್ತಾನ್ಯು
^32ಪಾಲನಂಪರದತ್ತಾಪಹರಣೇನಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ ನಿಷ್ಫಲಂಭವೆತ್ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಪುತ್ರಿ
^33ಕರಧಾತ್ರೀಪ್ರಿತ್ಯಾದತ್ತಾ ಸಹೋದರೇ | ಅನ್ಯದತ್ತಾಸ್ವಯಂವತಾಸಿಪದ
^34ತಸ್ಯವಸುಂಧರಾ || ದಾನಫಲನದೂರ್ಮೋಥ್ಯೂದಾನಾಚ್ಚ್ಯೋಯೋನುಸಲಸನಂ |
^35ದಾನಾತ್ಸ್ವರ್ಗಮವಾಪ್ನೋತಿಪಾಲನಾದಚ್ಯುತಪದಂ || ಮದ್ಯೆಂಜೂಜಃ

text.location: At Bestarahalli (Billur hobli), copy of a copper inscription.*
text.remarks:
Obeisance to Gaṇādhipati. Praises of Śiva, Gaṇēśa, Varāha and Sarasvatī.
Usual account of the descent of Yadu from the moon. In his line were many
kings, among whom was Bukka, whose wife was Magāmbikā. From them
(omitting laudations) was born Saṅgama, whose wife was Mānāmbikā, and
they had five sons,— Harihara, Kampa, Bukka, Māra, and Mudda. The eldest
of these became the ruler of the nine continents. Having conquered in all
points of the compass, he was served by the kings of Aṅga Kaliṅga and other
countries. And he ruled in Kuñjarakōṇa-puri (Ānegundi). On one occasion
he crossed the Tuṅgabhadrā with the intention of hunting, and coming forth
with his army, saw the forests to the south. And in the forest, that moon to
the ocean Saṅgamēśa was surprised to see a fierce dog with long teeth, only
chewing what had been bitten, and a hare. And seeing the god Virūpāksha
along with the goddess Pampā, he did obeisance to them; and drawing near,
paid respect to Vidyāraṇya, the yati in that temple, and informed him of the
above very curious circumstance. The yatīndra, acquainted with the three
times (past, present and future), smiled and said,—“O king, this place is worthy
to be the residence of a family of great kings; this is a specially strong site.
Make here a city named Vidyā, equal to Alaka (Kubēra's city), with nine
gates, wherein you may reside, like Purandara, in wealth acquired by victory
in war on all sides, and hold the world in your serpent-like arms.” Thereupon
Hariharēśvara, according to his direction, was seated on the throne,
adorned with the white umbrella, and made the sixteen great gifts, resplendent
in the nagara (or city) called Vidyā (or Vidyānagara) of vast dimensions.
	(On the date specified), during the *phalābhiṣhēka* festival for Pampā-Virū-
pāksha-Mahēśvara, he formed certain agrahāras. And (with praises) to Are-
kere Bhāskara's son Pampāvirūpāksha, he gave Yāraguḍi in Tummadāmala,
la in the Koṇḍakamala Vallūr-śīme, in the Yakuri-nivṛtti belonging to the
Ghanaśaila-puri kingdom. Its boundaries. And he gave it the new name of
Vidyāraṇyapura. And for the worship of the god Mahēśvara of Śrīśaila he
granted Chiravārapalli.
	By order of the king the śāsana was engraved by the śāsanāchārya
Nāga-dēva.
	Boundaries in the language of the country (Telugu). Usual final impre-
catory verses.
(signed) Śrī-Virūpāksha.

Bagepalli Talug.

Footnote
1. From its date this inscription would be of special interest, if authentic, but it cannot be depended on, being printed from a hand-copy supplied by the people, no original being forthcoming. text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಮಾರಾಗಂಕುಂಟ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ಯಾನಭೋಗ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣಪ್ಪನ ಹೆಂಡತಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣಮ್ಮನಲ್ಲಿದ್ದತಮ್ಮ ಶಾಸನ.ತೆಲುಗು.Their inscription in the possession of Krishnamma, wife of the Shanbhog Krishnappa in the same village of Maragankunta of the same hobli.Telugu.^1ನಮಸ್ತುಂಗಶಿರಶ್ಚುಂದಿಚಂದ್ರಚಾಮರಚಾರವೆತ್ರೈ^2ಲೋಕಸ್ಯಗರಾರಂಭಮೂಲಸ್ತಂಭಾಯಶಂಭವೆ ||^3ಹರೇರ್ಲೀಲಾವರಾಹಸ್ಯದಂಷ್ಟ್ರಾಂಡೋದ್ದತ್ವತ್ಪಾತನಹೇಮಾದ್ರಿ^4ಶಿರಾಯತಧರಾತ್ರೆತ್ರೈತ್ರಿತ್ರಯಂದಧಾ || ^5 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕ^6ದ್ಬಾಂಬುಲ ಒ೬೬೬ ಅಗುನನೆತಿಶ್ರೇಮುಖನಾಮಸಂ ॥ ^7 ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠ ಶುದ್ಧ ೧೬ ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ಸ್ಯಮಹಾಘನವಿನಾಡಪ್ರಭು^8ಲ್ಯ್ನಪಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜವನ್ನಿರೇಗಣಿನವರಿಸುತ್ಯ್ನಮನ್ನುದ್ಯನಾರಾಯಣಸ್ವಾಮಿವಿಪ್ರಪುತ್ರಲ್ಯ್ನರಂಗಪ್ಪ^9ಯ್ಯ್ನಗಪುನಿನವಾರಣ್ವೇಮುಅಭಸಂಘಸೂತ್ರಲ್ಯ್ನಯಜುಶಾಖಾಧ್ಯಾಮ್ಯುಲಕ್ಯ್ನಕರ್ಣಸಗೋತ್ರೋ^10ದ್ಬ ವೃಲ್ಲೃತಸಂಬಂಧಯ್ಯ್ನಗರಿಂಘಪತ್ಯಲ್ಯ್ನವೇಂಕಟಪತಯ್ಯ್ನಗಾಪುತ್ಯಲ್ಯ್ನವೇಂಕಲಮ್ಮಯ್ಯ್ನಗಾರನೆಮಾಂ^11ಕುಮ್ಯ್ನಯೊಂಕಿಟ್ಯ್ನತಬ್ಧಅಧಿಪಾಧನಮಹಾಶಾಸನಮುನ್ನುವಕ್ಕಟೊನ್ನನವಾಬಾರುಮಿದಮುಲನುಂ^12೧೬ ಮಂಮುವನುಅಶ್ರಿಯೊಂಚಿಅಂನಸ್ತಿ ಥಾಅದಸೆಚಿಪ್ಪ್ಯ್ನಕುಂಟುಪೊಂಟಿಂಗನಕಅದೇಪ್ರಕಾ^13ರಂಗಾನವಾಕುಪುತ್ರೊತ್ಸಕಾಲಮಂದು ಅನೇಕಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣುಲಕುಪದಕಮಹಾಧಾನಾ^14ಲುಚೇಕಾಲಮವಂದುವಿಚಾರಣ್ಣಪಕಾಚೇ ಕಳಿನವರುದವಯುಖುನಿವತ್ತೈಥುಡುಗಾನ^15ಕುಪುತ್ರಿನಾಮವ್ಯ್ನವನಾಯಿತಿ ಕಡುಗಾನಕುನುಕಳ್ಳಿ ದಿಕಸಮವಹಾರಾಗಾಣಿಕುಂಟಿ ವ್ಳತ^16ಮ್ಯ್ನಮಮಜರಾಹೇಂರಂಪಲ್ಲೆ ಗೋತ್ರತಿಪೇಟ್ರಪೂಲಮುಅಳುನಪಕಟುಯಿಕೆಂದ^17ನೀರಾರಂಭಂಒಮಿ ಯುಷ್ಯ್ನಲೊಂಟುಪೊಂಟಿಚಂತತೆಪೇಸನಹಾಮವ್ಯ್ನದಾನಾಜಕತಿಸುಕೊನಿ^18ನೀಲಟಿಹಂಸೊನಪಲ್ಲೆ ವಿಕಾಸಸಿಹರಿಯೊಕ್ಕೇದಾನಧಾರಪೂಪವರ್ಷಕಾಂಗಮಾವ್ಯ್ನ^19ಪ್ಪದೈನೆತಪ್ಪಿತ್ಯ್ನಗಾಯ್ಚ್ಟೆನಾರಮಮುನು ಕಾಯಿನಪಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಜ್ಚಳ್ಳ ಭೋಮಿತೂಪೂತ^20ತ್ಮುಕ್ಕುವಚೆಪ್ಪಿಕುಂಟಲೊ ನಿಲ್ಲವ್ಯ್ನಾಗಣಹದಧದ್ರಕ್ಟಣಕೊಟ್ಟು ಕುಂಜಾಲಪಲ್ಲೆ ಪೂ^21ಲ್ಲನೆರಹದಧು ರಕ್ಷೆ ಮಂಡಟ್ಟು ಕುಮಾದವ್ಯ್ನಪಾರಿಪಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂಲಿಮಿರಹದಧ್ರುತ್ರಂ^22ಕಟ್ಟುಕುಬಲ್ಲೆ ಪಲ್ಲೆ ಪೂಲಿಮಿರಲೊಂಬಹದಧ್ಯುಮಾವ್ಯ್ನ್ಯತೆಕಾಣರಹ^23ಣ್ಣಿಕಾರಣರಭ^24೧೬ ೧೭ ರಣರಭುಲೊಂನಿಧಿಕ್ಷೇಪಜಲತರು ಮಹಾಪಾಣಾಶ್ವೀಣಅಗಾಮಿಮುಖ್ಯಸದೃ^25ಮುಅಲನೆಅಷ್ಟಭೋಗೇಗಣ್ಯವ್ಯ್ಮುಲನುಅನುಭವಿಸುಂಚಿಕೊಣುವಿರಾದುವಿನಾಃ^26ಸಕುಅಜ್ಜ ವಳಿನಜೋಣಿಆದಿನಿ ಗಿ ೧೦ಲಿಂ ಆಕ್ರಾಲನವಿದಿವದವರಹಲುರೊಕಾಧಿ^27ವಾಣಾನಕಅಜ್ಜು ಕೊನ್ನಿನಿವಾಪುತೃತ್ಸಪರಂಪರಗಾಂಪಲ್ಲೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸುಂಕೊನಿ^28ಸುಖುನವಂದೇ || ನರಿಕಕಣಿಕತ್ಮುಂಟುಣಿವಾನಿಷ ರಷಜೆಕಿಶನಪುರ್ವಕಂ^29ಗಾಮ್ಯ್ಚಿ ನಾರಮುಮುಗನುಕವಿದುರ್ಗಂತಲಾಳಕಾಲತವಾನಕೊಚಾಟಾರಂಒಂ^30ಕೃ ಸೌಲೆಲ್ಯ್ಲು ಲಸಹಾwನ್ಯಸುಕೋಸಿವಿಗಂಚೆಣವುರ್ವೆದಿನಿಯ್ನಾಯೊಂಚಿ ಯು^31ಚೆಟ್ಟಿ ನಭೂಮಿನಾಧಮೂ ಕಾಲನವ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಂದಿಗುಣಾಂಪುಣ್ಯಂಪರದತ್ತಾನ್ಯು^32ಪಾಲನಂಪರದತ್ತಾಪಹರಣೇನಸ್ವದತ್ತಾ ನಿಷ್ಫಲಂಭವೆತ್ || ಸ್ವದತ್ತಾಪುತ್ರಿ^33ಕರಧಾತ್ರೀಪ್ರಿತ್ಯಾದತ್ತಾ ಸಹೋದರೇ | ಅನ್ಯದತ್ತಾಸ್ವಯಂವತಾಸಿಪದ^34ತಸ್ಯವಸುಂಧರಾ || ದಾನಫಲನದೂರ್ಮೋಥ್ಯೂದಾನಾಚ್ಚ್ಯೋಯೋನುಸಲಸನಂ |^35ದಾನಾತ್ಸ್ವರ್ಗಮವಾಪ್ನೋತಿಪಾಲನಾದಚ್ಯುತಪದಂ || ಮದ್ಯೆಂಜೂಜಃ

cells.remarks: (Telugu)—(In the year specified), the mahâ-nâyakâchârya Gummi-Nâyini Nârasimha-Nâyini's son Kadirappa-Nâyini granted to Miṭṭemari Mêkala Bomma a *daśavanda* as follows:—In Miṭṭemari-sthala the Liṅgânu-vaḍu being breached, and you having repaired and enlarged it, from the wet land under it one-fourth part is granted to you as *daśavanda*, to be enjoyed by you and your posterity—except the ………

on a copper plate in possession of Gaṇṭlanna, son of Bommi-redḍi.
(Telugu characters)

śrī-Rāmā Dhātu-sam || Bhādrapada-śu 10 lu śrīman-mahā-nāyakāchāryulayina
Gummi-Nāyani Narasimha-Nāyani komāra Kadirappa-Nāyaniguru Miṭṭēmarri-
Mékala-Bommugāniki vrāyiñchi yichchina dasavunadam vappa Miṭṭēmarri-
sthalaṁlōnu Liṅgānu-vaḍu sithilamayi vuṇḍagā nūtanamugā vistāramayina
pani chēyistivi ganuka anduna achchu-tēlina maḍi dasavandam chatur-bhāgam
śalav ichchināmu ni-putra-pautra-pāramparyangā anubhāviñchukoni sukhāna
vuṇḍēdi kāvali bōdigelu hortu

* So in the original. Verses are numbered as per original copy.

ಶ್ರೀ-ರಾಮಾ ಧಾತು-ಸಂ || ಭಾದ್ರಪದ-ಶು 10 ಲು ಶ್ರೀಮನ್-ಮಹಾ-ನಾಯಕಾಚಾರ್ಯುಲಯಿನ
ಗುಮ್ಮಿ-ನಾಯನಿ ನರಸಿಂಹ-ನಾಯನಿ ಕೊಮಾರ ಕದಿರಪ್ಪ-ನಾಯನಿಗುರು ಮಿಟ್ಟೇಮರ್ರಿ-
ಮೇಕಲ-ಬೊಮ್ಮುಗಾನಿಕಿ ವ್ರಾಯinchಿ ಯಿಚ್ಚಿನ ದಸವುನದಮ ವಪ್ಪ ಮಿಟ್ಟೇಮರ್ರಿ-
ಸ್ಥಲṁlōನು ಲಿಂಗಾನು-ವಡು ಸಿತಿಲಮಯಿ ವುṇḍಗಾ ನೂತನಮುಗಾ ವಿಸ್ತಾರಮಯಿನ
ಪನಿ ಚೇಯಿಸ್ಟಿವಿ ಗನುಕ ಅಂದುನ ಅಚ್ಚು-ತೇಲಿನ ಮಡಿ ದಸವಂದಂ ಚತುರ್-ಭಾಗṁ
ಶಲವ ಇಚ್ಚಿನಾಮು ನಿ-ಪುತ್ರ-ಪೌತ್ರ-ಪಾರಂಪರ್ಯಂಗಾ ಅನುಭಾವಿಂಚುಕೊನಿ ಸುಖಾನ
ವುṇḍೇದಿ ಕಾವಲಿ ಬೋದಿಗೆಲು ಹೋರ್ತು


Śrī Rāma, Dhatu year || Bhadrapada śu 10, the son of Gummi-Nayani Narasimha-Nayani, the great nāyakāchārya, Kadirappa-Nayaniguru, wrote and gave to the people of Mekala-Bommugani of Miṭṭēmarri—as the Liṅga at Miṭṭēmarri-sthala had become ruined and you have caused new and extensive work to be done, therefore we have given the fourth share of the stamped/selected maḍi (land) as dasavanda (service grant), to be enjoyed by you and your sons, grandsons and descendants in regular succession, and to live in happiness, along with bōdigelu (channels/rights).

(Tamil)—The strong-armed Vîra-Nârâyaṇa, [maṇḍalika of Koyyakurai-nâḍu], . . . .laganâra-devar, seems to have made, with pouring of water, a grant of certain lands (specified), for as long as the moon and the sun endure, to Aiyyar Alaagar Śellappiḷḷai Nâyan and ten others, having formed the lands into 12½ shares. cells.location: At Bôdigundalahalli (Muṅganahalli hobli), on Yeṇḍâpalu-bande, east of the village.
cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: (Telugu)—śrī-Râma. text.remarks:
(Tamil)—I, . . . . . . . . . one of the feudatories of the strong-armed Vîra-Nârāyaṇa—the maṇḍalika of Koygaikuru-nâḍu—granted, as a *sarva-mânya*, certain lands (specified) to Râjakkal-Nâyaṇâr, who was . . . . . . . . of the pure Śaiva [philosophy] handed down in uninterrupted succession from Sadâśiva to . . . . guru, and who was the family guru to the Chôla, Pâṇḍya and [*Kēraḷa*] kings.

Râmabhadra again and again entreats all future kings that they should from time to time protect this bridge of virtue, which is common to all kings.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿಯ ಬೋಡೇನಹಳ್ಳಿ ಊರೋಣ್ಯಂತ ಕೋಡೀಬಳ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡೆ ಮೇಲೆ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 10' × 16'.

^1ಶ್ರೀರಾಮ
^2ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀವಿಜಯಾಭ್ಯುದ
^3ಯಶಾಲಿವಾಹನಶಕವರಷಂ
^4ಮುಲು ೧೬೬೯ ಅಗಣೇವೈಭವ
^5ವಸಂವತ್ಸರಕೃತ್ಯಬಂ ೧೦ಲು
^6ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ತುಹಾಳವತಿನ
^7ಡಪ್ಪಯುವಂಶದಿನಾರಾಜುವಿನವರ್ಗಿನಿವಾರಿ
^8ಕಾರ್ಯಕರ್ತಲುವಿನಸಿದನಿಯಲ್ಲಿಮಲ್ಲನಾಯಿನಿಕೆಣ
^9ನಮಮನಾಯಿನಿಗಾರಣೇರಾಮದಾಸುತಳೋಶೀತಯಚೆನ್ನ
^10ಯುತಿಂವದಾಸರಿಯಿದುಳಮಮರನತಿಂಮಯುಗರೆಂಬ
^11ಯುಅಂತಂಮೆಗುದೆವೆಪೂದಮುಮುರನಾಳೋಹವರಶಬಿನ
^12ಅಪ್ಪ್ಯನಾಯುಷತೇರಬಲಯಿರಗಾಹಯುಮುದೆಗಳುವಾಂಕಿವಾಂಯಿಚ್ಛಿ
^13ಯುತಿಟ್ರಿ ನಚರಊರುವಿನದವಕಶೀಲಾಸಾಸನಮುವ[ಮೆ]ಟ್ಟಿಲಣ್ಣನುಮಾನಾಯಂಕೊಂಕಂಟಿ
^14ತಿಪೋಡಪಲಿಸ ಆಳೋಪೆಡಚರುಕನ್ಯಕಳಿಪುಂಡಗಾಯಿದಿನಮುವಂದ
^15ರಿಅಂದಮೇಲಾರಂನಸೆಣಿಯೊಂಖ್ಯೆನ್ಯನಿಮವಾಚನಯುಕ್ತೆ
^16ನಿನಿನಯಂಗ ೧೦೦ ನೂತಕಿವ್ಯಕುಮವಿದಲೋವೃತ್ತಮನದಹ
^17ಮಚೆಜೊಂಬದರಾಜಖ || ೧೦ ಮದಿನೇಅತ್ನನಗಳಾಚೆಜ್ಜ ತಿರೆಮದು
^18ಸರಿಪಾಲುದಸೇವಂದೆ^circನಡಪಗೆಲವಾರಮುಖವಿಬನವತ್ಸರಕಾತ್ರಿF
^19ಕಾಲು ಕಲಾ ಬರುಗಂಡಿಪೊಯಿಂದನundನಸಬೆಜೊಂಖ್ಯೆ ನನಿನಯ
^20ಮುಂಗಾ ೧೦ ವರಹಲುಕುಪ್ಯಕುವಮಡಿಲೋಜೊಬಿ ೧೦ ಮದಿವುಭಯ
^21ಚೊಂಟುಖ ಬಿ ||೧೦ ಪರಿವಿಡುದೆಮುಮುಜಡಸವ[೦]ದೆಂವಿಅನಾಪುತ್ರಪ್ರಸಾ
^22ತ್ರಪೂರೆಪರಂಮುತ್ತಾಳಚಂಡುರ್ಕಾಸಾನ್ನ ಯುಗಾನದಹೆಗಳವಾ
^23ರಮನಿವ್ರಾಯಿಯಂಜಿಡಿಯಚಿಟ್ಟ ನಳಿಕಾಶಾನಮುವಮಿಯಂದುಕ (ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ) ಸಾ
^24ಕಾಲಲಸುಣೂಯಾಚೆಂದ್ರಾದುಲುಯಿಂದುಕಕರ್ನಾಟಕಕಟಸಕುಲಪಿತೇಕಾಳಿಲೋಗೇ
^25ವುನುಚೆಜಿನನಪವನಾಪುಧರುತರುತುವಾರು . ತಹದಿನಿಕಿನಿನಪಪಾ
^26ಮನಪಪ್ರೋದುರುಸ್ವಾಮಿನಾಮಾನ್ಯಉಲುಪೂರ್ವಾಯಮರಿಯಾದಅನಿನಿವನಾಯಿನಿಗಾ
^27ರುಮನ್ಯಭಸಂತವ್ಯಕರಹಾಫಕಲು ಶಲು ಮುಂಗಾನಿಸಿಲ್ಲ ಕರಣಮುವ
^28ನಾರಾಯಣಪಗಾರಿಕಿವೇಪಿನಿದಲಕದೊಂಬೆರೇವಿಮುಗಾನಸು
^29ಅಂತೋಡೆದುಮುವಡಿವಾನ್ಮಯುಚ್ಚಿನಾರಂಗನುಗಪುತ್ರ
^30ಪ್ರತ್ಯಪಾಳಿಂವದಯುಂತಂಡದಪಗಲವಾರಮುವಣಾ
^31ಪ್ರಳ್ಳು ೧೦೬ೆ ವಿವರಮು
^32ಚಿಂಬನಳಪಿನಾಯಿನಿವಪಾಲು ೧

cells.remarks: (Tamil)—(On the date specified), I, Dêvâṇḍi-chchôṇyan, the strong-armed Vîra-Nârâyaṇa, the maṇḍalika of Koygaikkuru-nâḍu, made a grant, with pouring of water, for as long as the moon and the sun endure, of certain lands (specified), [to be enjoyed] as a *maḍappuram*, to Sadâśiva-dêva, the *tâna- pati* [in the temple] of the god Muttîśvaram-uḍaiya-nâyanâr on the hill near ….. *paḷḷi*. Prosperity. Râmabhadra again and again entreats all future kings that they should from time to time protect this bridge of virtue, which is common to all kings. I beg of you, future kings, that you should maintain the land granted to a Brâhmaṇa. Maintaining [a gift] is superior to making a gift. By this [charity], I amassed the wealth of virtue. I have [at the same time] respectfully placed on my head the two feet of him who has made it his duty to maintain this. People of all times are the protectors of this. He who confiscates land, whether given by himself or by another, is born a worm in ordure for sixty thousand years. Usual final imprecatory sentence.

cells.king: Achyuta-Râya
cells.language: Sanskrit and Kannada
cells.remarks: Obeisance to Śambhu etc. Praise of the Boar and Gaṇeśa. Usual account of the rise of the Lunar race, to Yayâti's son Turvasu. In his line was Timma-bhūpati. Birth of Nṛsiṁhēndra and Kṛshṇa-Râya. Then came Achyuta-Râya, who (on the date specified) granted to Chikkayâchârya the Miṇḍagal village. The śāsana was composed by Svayambhu, and engraved by Virana's son, the carpenter Viranâchârya. Usual final verses.

text.location: Copy of a sâsana from Miṇḍagal-jôḍidâr.
text.remarks:
Obeisance to Śambhu etc. Praise of the Boar and Gaṇeśa.

Usual account of the rise of the Lunar race, to Yayâti's son Turvasu. In
his line was Timma-bhūpati. Birth of Nṛsiṁhēndra and Kṛshṇa-Râya. Then
came Achyuta-Râya, who (on the date specified) granted to Chikkayâchârya
the Miṇḍagal village. The śāsana was composed by Svayambhu, and engraved
by Virana's son, the carpenter Viranâchârya. Usual final verses.

cells.remarks: Be it well. In the Śaka year 970, the year Sarbbajit,—to the taker of srîmat-Vîra-Pâṇḍiya's head, and Sērama's (the Chēra king's) Sâle, Kôv-Irâja- kēsaripadma, who was the Udeyâr śrî-Râjâdhirâja-Dēva, the 30th of his reign:— When śrîmat daṇḍanāyaka-Appimayya, who was the okkettu champion, the Nârāyaṇa of champions, Chôḷa's lion, Râjēndra-Chôḷa-Brahma mârāya, ruling the Mârâjavâḍi Seven Thousand, was in the camp at Vallûr, ruling in peace and wisdom;—on Muruganamale Muddarasa's son Bairayya, who was Râjēndra-Chôḷa-Pompala-mârâya, having a new tank called Pallavakaṭṭu constructed in Miṇḍuṅgallu of Koyyakoṇe-nāḍu, having the sluice fixed, and levelling the ground,—and having the ruin(ed part) of the god Sômēśvara's temple repaired and plastered over,—Appimayya, who was Râjēndra-Chôḷa- Brahmamârâya, gave for the god Sômēśvara of this village, of the first Chintamani Taluq. at the sluice of the Pallavagaṭṭu, according to the Chôlaṇa-siṅgam koḷaga, a kaṇḍuga of rice land. And building a tank called the northern Pompalakaṭṭu, and having the sluice fixed, he granted five koḷagas of rice land at that tank, for the perpetual lamp one oil-mill in this village, and for the priest ten koḷagas of rice land,—as a meritorious gift from the king to the god Sômêśvara. Whoso ruins this work of merit, falls into the sin of destroying cows and Bāṇarāsi. Footnote 1. See note to Bagepalli No. 70. This present inscription is also from a copy given by the people, there being no original. It is full of mistakes in the order of verses etc. Universitätsbibliothek Heidelberg. - Signatur: inf 26 K 170:10 Reproduktion, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung.

cells.remarks: (Tamil)—May high position tend to high character. May .... position tend to prosperity .................. (Usual final Sanskrit verse.) (On the date specified), I, Irâgava-dêvan, — the mahâ-maṇḍalîśvara, the strong-armed Vîra-Nârâyaṇa, Aiyyan-aṅkakāra, Nâḷêrkkaṇḍa, the maṇḍalika of Koygaikkuru-nâḷu — made, for my benefit, with pouring of water, the following grant, exempt from taxes, for the evening worship, in my name— Nâḷêrkkaṇḍa, of the god Bhîmîśvaram-uḍaiya-nâyaṇâr of Kaivâram in Nigarili- Śôḷa-maṇḍalam: — Among the villages in the districts (named) which came under my rule (in 1280 A. D.) on my victory in battle over Gaṅgapperumâḷan Tiru-chChiṅgam- bala-ṅâla-nâyan Brahmarâyar at Ambâḍakki in Tanda-nâḷu and ........, the village of Periyaṇappaḷḷi with the wet and dry lands, the trees overground and the wells underground, included within its four boundaries, together with some other wet lands (specified). This is to continue for as long as the moon and the sun endure. I also set up a stone inscription to the above effect. He who alters this shall be the perpetrator of the five great sins on the banks of the Ganges and shall be the husband of his own mother. (Usual final phrase.)

text.remarks:
(Tamil)—May high position tend to high character. May .... position
tend to prosperity .................. (Usual final Sanskrit verse.)

(On the date specified), I, Irâgava-dêvan, — the mahâ-maṇḍalîśvara, the
strong-armed Vîra-Nârâyaṇa, Aiyyan-aṅkakāra, Nâḷêrkkaṇḍa, the maṇḍalika
of Koygaikkuru-nâḷu — made, for my benefit, with pouring of water, the
following grant, exempt from taxes, for the evening worship, in my name—
Nâḷêrkkaṇḍa, of the god Bhîmîśvaram-uḍaiya-nâyaṇâr of Kaivâram in Nigarili-
Śôḷa-maṇḍalam: —

Among the villages in the districts (named) which came under my rule
(in 1280 A. D.) on my victory in battle over Gaṅgapperumâḷan Tiru-chChiṅgam-
bala-ṅâla-nâyan Brahmarâyar at Ambâḍakki in Tanda-nâḷu and ........, the
village of Periyaṇappaḷḷi with the wet and dry lands, the trees overground
and the wells underground, included within its four boundaries, together with
some other wet lands (specified).

This is to continue for as long as the moon and the sun endure. I also
set up a stone inscription to the above effect. He who alters this shall be the
perpetrator of the five great sins on the banks of the Ganges and shall be
the husband of his own mother. (Usual final phrase.)

cells.remarks: (Tamil).— In the 3rd year of the reign of the emperor of the whole world Hôśaḷa śrî-vîra-Viśvaṇâ-Dêvar.— I, Mukkaṇa-Kâḍuveṭṭi Pallavâdittan Śîpati-nâyan, son of Kitaraśar of Kuṛumbûr, granted (on the date specified) Kaṭṭigaippalli, situated to the east of this village, as a dêvadâna, for the god Vijaya-Mâdîśvaram-uḍaiyâr. cells.remarks: The feet of Tiruveṅgaḷanâtha are the refuge. Be it well. (On the date specified), the mahârâjâdhirâjâ râja-paramêśvara vīra-pratâpa,—worshipper of the lotus feet of the master of the universe and of myriads of worlds, the ancient Purushôttama, the god Veṅkaṭêśvara,— of the Bhôsala-vaṁśa, Śembhôji-Râja's son Malukôji-Râja, granted for the god Tiru- veṅgaḷanâtha, free of all imposts, the Âvalambagiri village, belonging to Kaivâra-sthala, in the Kôḷâla-śīme, one of the seven nāḍs attached to the Hosa..lu-châvaḍi during the government of Śivâji-Râja-mahârâja,—which the illustrious Chetrapati Śivâji-mahârâjâdhirâja had granted to Malukôji-Râja as a mirâsi.—Regulations for the great car festival. Apparently also a grant of Koṇḍadarahalli, a hamlet of Âvalambagiri, for some service at Yêrukâḷave. Imprecation. *Chintamani Talug.* Footnote 1. The Śaka year given is 4485 and the Kali year 1485—a curious interchange. Both the years are clearly wrong, as the inscription is of the time of Ballâla III. cells.remarks: (Tamil)—During the rule over the earth of the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara, destroyer of hostile kings, champion on kings who break their word, śrî-vira- Bukkanṇa-uḍaiyar— (On the date specified), we—the mahâ-sâmantâdhipati Śipati-nâyakka's son Śoṇṇeya-nâyakkar and the inhabitants of Ambaḍakki-nâḍu, including the superintendents of the nâḍu, Pâpa-chchîyar, Śokki-śiyar and others (three named)—granted certain lands (specified), as a kuḍangai exempt from taxes, to Śanâṇḍai, son of ......śiyar. The writing of Nilappar, the accountant of the nâḍu.

text.remarks:
(Tamil)—During the rule over the earth of the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara,
destroyer of hostile kings, champion on kings who break their word, śrî-vira-
Bukkanṇa-uḍaiyar—

(On the date specified), we—the mahâ-sâmantâdhipati Śipati-nâyakka's son
Śoṇṇeya-nâyakkar and the inhabitants of Ambaḍakki-nâḍu, including the
superintendents of the nâḍu, Pâpa-chchîyar, Śokki-śiyar and others (three
named)—granted certain lands (specified), as a kuḍangai exempt from taxes,
to Śanâṇḍai, son of ......śiyar. This .... is to continue as long as the moon
and the sun endure.

cells.remarks: *(This inscription is gone in parts and the meaning of some portions is not clear.)* (Tamil)—Be it well. Śeṭṭi-dēvan—whose arm was embraced by the goddess of the red lotus flower (Lakshshmi) which was full of honey; who was the son of Vindai (? Durgā) residing in the forest; who was the champion born in the line of the god of the lotus flower (Brahmā) which was not frequented by the ..... flower-seeking bees; who was of the Kauṇḍalya-gōtra; who was [the lord] of Kaivāra-nāḍu in which .......—having entered the paddy-fields on all sides, scattered ....... in every grove of the champaka trees and associated with .......... spread around and grown high—entered the ponds filled with red lotus flowers; who was holier than the Gaṅgā which .... ....; who was the son of Aṅgai-mugil-amudan, the lord of champions; who was a Brāhmaṇ .......; who cherished the path of Manu ........ on this great earth; ...........; who was the Duṭṭarāditta and Durkkula-nakula; and who was the Piramādirāyan with his fame spread all over the earth which is supported by the serpent .........— Śeṭṭi-dēvan—built a beautiful stone temple with a *maṇṭapa* in front of it, which was to the liking of the lord of the Silver Mountain (Śiva), who could be seen neither by Viṣṇu reclining on the banyan leaf nor by the god of the lotus flower (Brahmā), at Vidirachcheṭṭu, which resembled the sea on account of the joyous buzzing of swarms of bees in the flower-gardens (several flower plants named) and groves around; [set up] the god (on the date and at the auspicious moment specified), while .......... rejoiced, while ....... was seated ....... feet of many Brāhmaṇs, while the ascetics ....... the name Śeṭṭichcharam, while the holy adored the god, standing in all the eight directions which they illuminated like beautiful lamps, while the earth brought forth pleuty, while the great vēdas flourished, while the sky poured down __________________________________________________________________________________ **Universitätsbibliothek Heidelberg. - Signatur: inf 26 K 170:10** **Reproduktion, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung.** Chintamani Taluq. showers, and while the cruel Kali vanished; gave, with pouring of water, tax- free land to the famous Brâhman, Râjarâja-bhaṭṭaṉ, of the Kauśika-gōtra, for conducting the worship of Paśupati (Śiva); engraved [the grant] on stone; conferred the madāppattiyam of the temple on Tillai-ppirâṉ Arivâḍattây- âṇḍârar of Koṅgar-Kōḍimaṅgalam, alias Śōḻan ...... surrounded by fragrant groves; granted inalienable extensive lands to provide for the playing of musical instruments before the indescribable Para-Śiva; gave for the rider on the furious bull (Śiva) an ornamental plate weighing 5 kalañju of gold and vessels etc. which were of the same ? make, weighing 100 palam of bell-metal; granted the oil of two oil-mills for burning 10 lamps at the three times of the day; and made a grant of certain lands (specified) for the god. After he had made these immense charities—Namberumâḷ, alias Aḷavili Ariñan, a Brâhman of .......dalûr, praised by learned men, of sweet speech, a firm devotee of the god who wears the tulasi garland on his breast (Vishṇu), and a wise giver of gold, wrote this, after hearing what the maṇḍalika of the three nāḍu, praised by those versed in the three forms of Tamil, ........ ....... fame talked about in many assemblies, a mine of ......., the holy one with a liberal hand, the Duṭṭar-gaṇḍan (champion over the wicked), vouchsafed to order. Further, Piramâdirâyan-Śeṭṭi of unfailing promise, who was as liberal as the rain-cloud, having conferred, with the approval of many holy persons, the title of Irâyâśâri on Śaṅkara ......,—who was wise, merciful, rich and famous, and who made faultlessly and symmetrically the image of Aran (Hara), whose feet could not be seen even by the ancient vēdas, and the temple;—also granted certain (specified) lands to him. These charities are to continue as long as the moon and the sun endure ........

text.remarks:
*(This inscription is gone in parts and the meaning of some portions is not clear.)*

(Tamil)—Be it well. Śeṭṭi-dēvan—whose arm was embraced by the goddess
of the red lotus flower (Lakshshmi) which was full of honey; who was the son
of Vindai (? Durgā) residing in the forest; who was the champion born in the
line of the god of the lotus flower (Brahmā) which was not frequented by the
..... flower-seeking bees; who was of the Kauṇḍalya-gōtra; who was [the
lord] of Kaivāra-nāḍu in which .......—having entered the paddy-fields on
all sides, scattered ....... in every grove of the champaka trees and
associated with .......... spread around and grown high—entered the
ponds filled with red lotus flowers; who was holier than the Gaṅgā which ....
....; who was the son of Aṅgai-mugil-amudan, the lord of champions; who
was a Brāhmaṇ .......; who cherished the path of Manu ........ on this
great earth; ...........; who was the Duṭṭarāditta and Durkkula-nakula;
and who was the Piramādirāyan with his fame spread all over the earth
which is supported by the serpent .........—

Śeṭṭi-dēvan—built a beautiful stone temple with a *maṇṭapa* in front of it,
which was to the liking of the lord of the Silver Mountain (Śiva), who could
be seen neither by Viṣṇu reclining on the banyan leaf nor by the god of the
lotus flower (Brahmā), at Vidirachcheṭṭu, which resembled the sea on account
of the joyous buzzing of swarms of bees in the flower-gardens (several flower
plants named) and groves around; [set up] the god (on the date and at the
auspicious moment specified), while .......... rejoiced, while ....... was
seated ....... feet of many Brāhmaṇs, while the ascetics ....... the name
Śeṭṭichcharam, while the holy adored the god, standing in all the eight
directions which they illuminated like beautiful lamps, while the earth brought
forth pleuty, while the great vēdas flourished, while the sky poured down

showers, and while the cruel Kali vanished; gave, with pouring of water, tax-
free land to the famous Brâhman, Râjarâja-bhaṭṭaṉ, of the Kauśika-gōtra, for
conducting the worship of Paśupati (Śiva); engraved [the grant] on stone;
conferred the madāppattiyam of the temple on Tillai-ppirâṉ Arivâḍattây-
âṇḍârar of Koṅgar-Kōḍimaṅgalam, alias Śōḻan ...... surrounded by fragrant
groves; granted inalienable extensive lands to provide for the playing of musical
instruments before the indescribable Para-Śiva; gave for the rider on the
furious bull (Śiva) an ornamental plate weighing 5 kalañju of gold and
vessels etc. which were of the same ? make, weighing 100 palam of bell-metal;
granted the oil of two oil-mills for burning 10 lamps at the three times of the
day; and made a grant of certain lands (specified) for the god.

After he had made these immense charities—Namberumâḷ, alias Aḷavili
Ariñan, a Brâhman of .......dalûr, praised by learned men, of sweet speech,
a firm devotee of the god who wears the tulasi garland on his breast (Vishṇu),
and a wise giver of gold, wrote this, after hearing what the maṇḍalika of the
three nāḍu, praised by those versed in the three forms of Tamil, ........
....... fame talked about in many assemblies, a mine of ......., the holy
one with a liberal hand, the Duṭṭar-gaṇḍan (champion over the wicked),
vouchsafed to order.

Further, Piramâdirâyan-Śeṭṭi of unfailing promise, who was as liberal as
the rain-cloud, having conferred, with the approval of many holy persons, the
title of Irâyâśâri on Śaṅkara ......,—who was wise, merciful, rich and
famous, and who made faultlessly and symmetrically the image of Aran
(Hara), whose feet could not be seen even by the ancient vēdas, and the
temple;—also granted certain (specified) lands to him.

These charities are to continue as long as the moon and the sun endure

ಕೈವಾರ ಹುಬ್ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಕೈವಾರದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಬೆಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ದುರ್ಗಮ್ಮನ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ದಕ್ಷಿಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಡೆಮೇಲೆ.
೧ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಶಾಬ್ಬೆ ೧೫೧೯ ನೇಯಕಲಿಯುಗಸಂವತ್ಸರದ ಕ್ಲಿಂಗೆ ನೇಯು . . ಸ್ಯ್ಭಾಬನುಸಂವತ್ಸರದವಯುಖಿಒ ಲೂ
ಶ್ರೀಮತ್ತುಹಾಮಡಳೇಕ್ಷರ
೩ಅರಿರಾಯವಿಭಾಡಮಹೇಗೆತ್ರಸ್ಯವರಯುವರಗಂದರ: ಜಾದಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರೀವಿರೇಪ್ರತಾಪವೀರಮಹಾರಾಯರು |
೩ಪೃಥಿವೀರಾಜ್ಯಂಗುತ್ತೆಂ ಯೆಂರುಲಉಳವರಮನೆದೂನಾಯಕರು. .ಸಿರಮನೆಯಪ್ರಧಾನಿನವರದಪ್ಪಗಳಿಗೆಪುರುಡರೇಗ್ಯಲೆಯಿ
೪ಕ್ಕೈಯುವ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಯಾಗಬೇಕೆಂದುಪೂಕೇಚಕ್ರನಗರನಡಕಯಿವಾರದನದಿಯದುರ್ಗಾದೇವಿಯನುಸುಮುಹೂರ್ತ
ದಲ್ಲಿಕೃಷ್ಟಿಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನುನುವಾದಿಪತಿಷ್ಟ್ಯೆಯುವಯುವುತ
೫ಪದಿಗೆಕೆಯಿವಾರದಹಿರಿಯುಕೊಜಿಯಕೇಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಗ್ರಾಮುಖಿ || ಹೂಲಖಂ || ಯಿದನನಾಚಂದ್ರಾರ್ಕಕಸ್ತಾಯಿಯೋಗಿನದಿ
ಯುಲುಅರಸವಕ್ಸನಾ
೬ವಾಣಿದರೆಪೂಣಗೆಯುತ್ತಾ ದಿಯುಲುಕೂಲಿಯುಕೊಂಡಪಪದಲಿಹೋರರುನ್ನುದತ್ಯ್ಹಾಸರದತ್ತ್ಯಾ ಂವಾಯೋರ್ಯದೆತ್ರವಸುಮ

cells.remarks: May it be prosperous. Be it well. (On the date specified), when (with usual titles) Achyuta-Râya-mahârâya on his righteous throne was ruling the kingdom of the world:—to Chivanâ-bhaṭṭa's son Râmâ-bhaṭṭa,—during the management of Dhammathâsêni Jâmarasa's son Bhâskara-dêva,—Śakârasa's son..., in the villages belonging to the god Bhîmêśvara, set up by Bhîmasêna in Êkachakrapura, otherwise called Kayvara, and worshipped in the Dvâpara- yuga, granted certain payments (specified), to provide for the offerings, decorations and festivals of the god. Imprecations. This śāsana was set up during the management of Viramarasa.

May it be prosperous. Be it well. (On the date specified), when (with
usual titles) Achyuta-Râya-mahârâya on his righteous throne was ruling the
kingdom of the world:—to Chivanâ-bhaṭṭa's son Râmâ-bhaṭṭa,—during the
management of Dhammathâsêni Jâmarasa's son Bhâskara-dêva,—Śakârasa's
son..., in the villages belonging to the god Bhîmêśvara, set up by Bhîmasêna
in Êkachakrapura, otherwise called Kayvara, and worshipped in the Dvâpara-
yuga, granted certain payments (specified), to provide for the offerings,
decorations and festivals of the god. Imprecations.

This śāsana was set up during the management of Viramarasa.

cells.remarks: (Tamil)—In the 40th year of the reign of (with usual Hoysaḷa titles) Poyśaḷa-vīra-Râmanâda-Dêvar.— I—the great minister, a Yama-râja to maṇḍalikas, the fearless lord, champion over the three kings, Śikka-dêva-daṇṇāyakkar Aṇṇamalai-dêvar—, having instituted, for the benefit of the king's sacred body, a festival on the day of the star under which the king was born in the month of Śittirai, to provide for this festival for as long as the moon and the sun endure, and with Universitätsbibliothek Heidelberg - Signatur: inf 26 K 170:10 Reproduktion, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung. Chintamani Talug. the condition that the balance, after meeting without stint the expenses of the festival, should be devoted to the sacred service of Mudaliyâr, granted (on the date specified), with pouring of water, for as long as the moon and the sun exist, certain lands (specified), as a sarva-mânya, including the trees over- ground, the wells underground, water-courses, open grounds etc., together with all kinds of rights and taxes (named), for the god Bhîmîśvaram- uḍaiya-nâyanâr of Kaivâram in Kaivâra-nâḍu of Nigarili-Śôla-maṇḍalam. Having caused to be planted the sacred trident [of Śiva] in Nâyanpaḷḷi, and having caused [the grant] to be engraved on stone in the pañchângam, I granted [the above lands], as tax-free temple property, for the benefit of the king's sacred body and for the success of his arm. If there be any one who violates this charity, he shall not only incur the sin of one who has killed a tawny cow on the banks of the Ganges, but also be a traitor to his master, to his king and to his guru. May virtue be victorious. This is the signature of Aṇṇâmalai-dêvan.

text.remarks:
(Tamil)—In the 40th year of the reign of (with usual Hoysaḷa titles)
Poyśaḷa-vīra-Râmanâda-Dêvar.—

I—the great minister, a Yama-râja to maṇḍalikas, the fearless lord,
champion over the three kings, Śikka-dêva-daṇṇāyakkar Aṇṇamalai-dêvar—,
having instituted, for the benefit of the king's sacred body, a festival on the
day of the star under which the king was born in the month of Śittirai, to
provide for this festival for as long as the moon and the sun endure, and with

Universitätsbibliothek Heidelberg - Signatur: inf 26 K 170:10
Reproduktion, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung.

Chintamani Talug.
the condition that the balance, after meeting without stint the expenses of the
festival, should be devoted to the sacred service of Mudaliyâr, granted (on the
date specified), with pouring of water, for as long as the moon and the sun
exist, certain lands (specified), as a sarva-mânya, including the trees over-
ground, the wells underground, water-courses, open grounds etc., together
with all kinds of rights and taxes (named), for the god Bhîmîśvaram-
uḍaiya-nâyanâr of Kaivâram in Kaivâra-nâḍu of Nigarili-Śôla-maṇḍalam.
Having caused to be planted the sacred trident [of Śiva] in Nâyanpaḷḷi, and
having caused [the grant] to be engraved on stone in the pañchângam, I
granted [the above lands], as tax-free temple property, for the benefit of the
king's sacred body and for the success of his arm.

If there be any one who violates this charity, he shall not only incur the
sin of one who has killed a tawny cow on the banks of the Ganges, but also
be a traitor to his master, to his king and to his guru. May virtue be
victorious. This is the signature of Aṇṇâmalai-dêvan.

¹ஸவஸ்திஸ்ரீ காவயுக்திலஸு-ஸத்து நாலாயரத்து நாநூறு நாற்பத்தேட்டு

text.text_original: --- Grantha/Tamil original ---¹ஸவஸ்திஸ்ரீ காவயுக்திலஸு-ஸத்து நாலாயரத்து நாநூறு நாற்பத்தேட்டு²இதன்மேல் செல்லாநின்ற தா....ஹுஸ்திஸ்ரீமஹாமண்டலேசுர³ஸன் அரிஅரராயன் கோமரன் பக்காராயன் வாளுக்குந்தோளிருக்கும்⁴ஜயமாக அட்டவட்டைத்த்தாத்த்தில் வார்த்கும்பெருமாளும் செந்த⁵க்................ம் ஸவஸ்திஸ்ரீ நிகரிலிசோழமண்டலத்து கைக்⁶வாரநாட்டுக் கைவாரத்து உடையார் வீலூருடையாருக்கு. செல்லும் சில⁷ந்ததன்பன்னியம்......செல்லும் நாயன்........உன்ன பறையாமக்கம்⁸..................செல்லும்............உள்ளது தாரணவருஷத்து மா.⁹.............ல்த்தஸ்திகி................தீதேவரை ஸவஸ்திஜயவமாக செல்லகட¹⁰வதாக விட்டோம் இந்தத் தன்மத்தை மாற்றிவ மண்கைராயிற் குரால்பசுவை கொன்¹¹றூபவஸதிலே போவார்கள்.

--- Grantha/Tamil original ---
¹ஸவஸ்திஸ்ரீ சகலயாண்டுஉடூகாஸ்ர இதன்மேற் செல்லாநின்ற கலியு
²வருஷம் சளுசா .எக இதன்மேல் செல்லாநின்ற பார்த்திவவருஷத்துப் பங்கு
³ணிமாத .தற்றி ஹுஸ்திஸ்ரீ அண்ணாமக்களாத் துட்டராதித்த ராககாராயணை
⁴ஸுஜூராதிராயரான . வாசினியுங் குமாரன் சூத்தினியுஞ். யனுயக்கண்க
⁵ஸன் சொண்ணியநுபக்கனும் கைவாரத்தில் நாய.,.விமழூரமுடையா
⁶ற்கு முன்னாள் தேவதானமாகச் செல்லாநின்ற சலந்தயன்பள்ளியில் மேற்பொ
³ன் காணிக்கை கண்டாவும் தெண்டமுண்டிிகை தறிபிறை தட்டார்ப்பாட்டம் ஆசுவ
⁸க்கடமை எப்பேர்ப்பட்ட பலவரியும் சுறாதிதிவரை செல்லக்கடவதாக வை-மானியம்
⁹ரக விட்டோம் யிதுக்கு யியும்பண்ணிஞவன் மமகரையைற் குரட்பசுை
¹⁰வக் கொன்ற தோஷடம்பண்ணினவன்
¹¹ஸு-மவதியிலே போவார்கள்.

cells.remarks: (Tamil) — While the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara, destroyer of hostile kings, champion over kings who break their word, lord of the four oceans, śrî-vîra- Kampaṇṇa-udaiyar's son Jommaṇṇa-udaiyar was ruling the earth — (On the date specified), the great minister Dêvaṇṇa-udaiyar along with the inhabitants of Kaivâra-nâḍu, having, in order that religious merit might accrue to his father Îśvara-dêva, instituted a festival for the god Bhîmîśuram-uḍaiya-nâya- nâr of Kaivâram, granted, with pouring of water, for as long as the moon and the sun endure, certain lands (specified), including the trees overground and the wells underground, together with many taxes (a long list given) — among which may be mentioned Kampaṇṇa-udaiyar's present (kâṇikkai), Jommaṇṇa- udaiyar's present, the good oil, the good cow, the good bull, the good she- buffalo, and the tax on shoe-makers — for defraying the expenses of the above festival.

ಅದೇ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಉತ್ತರ ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವದ ತಳಪಾದಿ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಗ್ರಂಥ ಮತ್ತು ಅರವರೆಕ್ಷರ.

--- Grantha/Tamil original ---
^1௳ஸ்ரீஸ்ரீ கலியுவஸுவஸேஸாபு சதசனாழ் இடதநள் நீங்
^2திய ஸகலாப்நூ தடசுல்௨ இதின்மேல் செல்லாநின்ற ஆணயஸ..
^3வஸுவஸ்த்து பங்குனிமாதம் உல்க ௲ந்தி ஸ்ரீமஹாஜனோடேளு
^4ராரியாராயிலராரூ ௳ஹெஷெக்குத் தப்புவ ராடர மணுது சது
^5ஸமுத்பலிபதி ஸ்ரீ வீரசம்பண்ணஉடையார் குமாரன் ஜோம்மண்
^6ண உடையார் வுய்விராஜுபண்ணுகிற ஸ்ரீமமஹாராப்யா
7தி தேவண்ண உடையார் தங்கள் தோப்பனார் ௳ஹாடெவற்கு
8புண்ணியமாக கைவாராட்டாரும் வைவாரத்து ௳மீச்சுமு
9டைய நாயனாற்கு திருநாளாஞ் கற்பித்து இத்திருநாள் அழிவு
^10க்குக் கைவாராட்டிச் சிக்க. கல்லுக்கு அடைத் தஞ்செ
^11ய் புஞ்செய் காப்ரமல்லெவையும் மேல்கோக்கின மர
^12மும் கீழோக்கின கிணறும் பொன்வழிப்புவாதமை க..
^13பண்ண உடையார் காணிக்கை ஜோம்மண்ண உடைய
^14யர் காணிக்கை சாரிகை மகமை மக்கதிகை கார்த்திகைப்
^15படி உள்ளாயம்......நாட.......னை ஆடுெறை த
^16ண....கை தெண்டடம் உண்டிகை அ....ாயம்.
^17.....காணிப்பட்டு நற்யெண்ணெ நல்லெருது நற்பசு நல்
^18லருமை..தணி.....னித்.....டடு இரும்பு சக்கி
^19விசிறை வெற்றிலை....ம்மை மற்றும்மிலவூர்
^20..................காணிக்கையும் ௳வக்ராஜநியாக.
^21..................ல..........து தாரார்பூவமாக அஉ2
^22.............................................................

ಮುಂಭಾಗ,

^ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಸ್ರೀಚೆಕರವರುಸಲ್ಲುಅಂ ೧೫೪೩ ಅಗಿನೇ
^ಪ್ಲವಸಂವತ್ಸರಸಲ್ಲುಗಳ ೧೧ ಗುರುವಾರಾನ
^ಶ್ರೀಮನುಮಹಾ ಮನ್ನಾ ಲೇಕ್ಯರಲಂಡಾರುವಿ
^ಖುಳಬಿಸಿಗೇತ್ತೃವರಾಯರಗಂಡೆಧವೃಪ

^ಶ್ವರತುಂಬಾಳದ ಗೇ೯ವಟವನಸಂಕರತನಮಂಡಲಿ
^10ಜರಗಲಂಡ . ಜಜಲರಾವುವತ್ರದಾವ
^11ಜಂಗುಳವ . ರಗೆಚಸಲರಣದೇವರು

^18ಸ್ವಾಮಿಮದುವರಪ್ಪಿತ್ತವಮ್ಯಂಜುಪಚರಿಯನಾಯುಸನಪ್ಪಿ

text.text_original: On the foundation stone of the north side of the same temple.Grantha and half-letters.95ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಅಮರನಾರಾಯಣಸ್ವಾಮಿ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಈಶಾನ್ಯ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿದ್ದಿರುವಕಲ್ಲು.A stone lying in the north-east part of the Amaranarayanasvami temple in the same village.ಮುಂಭಾಗ,^ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಸ್ರೀಚೆಕರವರುಸಲ್ಲುಅಂ ೧೫೪೩ ಅಗಿನೇ^ಪ್ಲವಸಂವತ್ಸರಸಲ್ಲುಗಳ ೧೧ ಗುರುವಾರಾನ^ಶ್ರೀಮನುಮಹಾ ಮನ್ನಾ ಲೇಕ್ಯರಲಂಡಾರುವಿ^ಖುಳಬಿಸಿಗೇತ್ತೃವರಾಯರಗಂಡೆಧವೃಪ^ಸ್ಥ್ತಿ ವಸಸಮುದ್ರಾದಿಪತಿಯಿವಿರಲುಕೃಷ್ಣೈವೊ^ದಯರಕುಮಾರೊಂಡುಕಾಪ್ಪನ್ಯೈದೇಯು^ರು ಪೃಥ್ವಿರಾಜ್ಯಮುಸೆಯುಹುಂಡುಗಾನುವಾರಿನ^ಗಾರಿಬಲಮುನ್ನೆರಾಜಲುಸಸ್ವಿಸ್ತ್ರೀವುಮಹಾಮಂಡಲೇ^ಶ್ವರತುಂಬಾಳದ ಗೇ೯ವಟವನಸಂಕರತನಮಂಡಲಿ^10ಜರಗಲಂಡ . ಜಜಲರಾವುವತ್ರದಾವ^11ಜಂಗುಳವ . ರಗೆಚಸಲರಣದೇವರು^12ನಿಲಕ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರೂರುಂಡೂರುಂಡೆಯುಹಿಂಭಾಗ,^13ದೇವಮಹಾ: ರಾಜಲಾಸನತಿಶೈವಮುಮಹಾ^14ಕಾಯಿಯವರನಾಜಮನೆ ಗವ್ಯೊಂಡುಪಜಲನ್ನು ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಸವ^೧೫ಸ್ತ ನಿಜನಾನಾವಾಂಕವಾಳಿಕಾಪೃನ್ನಸ್ಥಿ ಸಹಿತೆಉಳಭೂಯಾನಾ^೧೬ನದಏಳಿಪವಸ್ತು ಪಕ್ಕೊಧ್ಯನ್ನು ಪದನೆನಿವಿದಿಸಮಯಾಲವಾ^17ರುನ್ಮ್ಯ ಕಾಯುವಾರಾಣಗಂತಕ್ಕಿಚಿಟಿಇಸಂತಕತುಪ್ಪtya^18ಸ್ವಾಮಿಮದುವರಪ್ಪಿತ್ತವಮ್ಯಂಜುಪಚರಿಯನಾಯುಸನಪ್ಪಿ^19ನಸಾಮಿಂಗಾನಿನೀಪಿತಾನಿಕಾಮುವಾರಂಪ್ರೆದದ ಜೇಜು^20ಪುದವನಕಪಂ . ಮು . ಪದಮುದಿನ್ನಿ ತಳಗಳವರೆದೇವಗೆವ^21 ತ್ಯತಜಡುವ . ಪಂನ್ನುಮೂಜೀನುನ್ನು ಸರ್ವವಾನ್ವ್ಯಂ^22ಗಾನಿಸೀವಿಜಯವನ್ವ್ಯೆತಪ್ಪಕಅಜಅಧ್ಯರ್ಕಗಾನಾಂಡಪ^23೬ಂಗಲವರಸಂಇವೇಳೀರಕುತಪ್ಪಿ ನವರೇಉಟಮರಣ್ರಾರಾ^24ಯುಣಪರವಮಾಳಕತಪ್ಪಿನವರುಮಂಗಲಮಹೋ್ಸ95 aಅದೇ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಒಳಗೆ.ನಾಗರಾಕ್ಷರ.Inside the same temple.Nagarakshara script.^1ಶುಭಮಸ್ತು ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಶಕಶಾಬ್ಲಿ ೧೧೪೬ . ಕಲಿವಷ೯ ೪೪. .ಜಯುನಾವಸುವತ್ಸರಡ. .ಕೃಷ್ಠ್ಯ....^...ಶ್ರಿಮನ್ಮಹಾಜರಾಜಧಿರಾಜರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರೀವಿರಪ್ರತಾಪಮಹಾಹಾಂಹರಾರಾಯ......3 . . . . . . . . ಯೆರಡಗಳ . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .4 . . . . . . . . . . . . ಕಳಲು . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .5 ಸನಗಣ . . . . . . . . . . . . ವೆಂಕಟಪ್ಪ ನಾಯಕಯ್ಯಾ ವರದಅಮರನಾರಾಯಣದೇವರಗೆ . . . . . .6 . . . . ಕೈಯ್ಯುಮುದ್ದನಾದ . . . . . . . . . . ಶಾಸನ . . . . . . . . .7 . . . ಯೇನಲ್ಲ . . . . . . . ಅಚೆಂದ್ರಾಕ್ಕಸ್ಥಾಯಿಯಾಗಿ . . . . . .8 . . . . ಶೀದೇವರುಗಳ . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .(ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ).96-100ಅದೇ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ತಳಪಾದೀ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ.ಗ್ರಂಥ ಮತ್ತು ಅರವೆಕ್ಷರ.101-103ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ನಕುಲೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ತಳಪಾದೀ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ.ಗ್ರಂಥ ಮತ್ತು ಅರವೆಕ್ಷರ.

cells.remarks: (Tamil)—During the rule of Aṇṇaṇ-aṅkakâra-tTuṭṭarâditta Brahmâdhirâyar, alias Śelva-Gaṅga-dêvar of Kaivâram in Nigarili-Śōḷa-maṇḍalam— I, Kumarândai Tiruvâḷar, granted for the god Piḷḷaiyâr, set up by me, certain lands (specified, with boundaries) which I had purchased after making full payment in gold. text.remarks:
(Tamil)—During the rule of Aṇṇaṇ-aṅkakâra-tTuṭṭarâditta Brahmâdhirâyar, alias Śelva-Gaṅga-dêvar of Kaivâram in Nigarili-Śōḷa-maṇḍalam—

I, Kumarândai Tiruvâḷar, granted for the god Piḷḷaiyâr, set up by me, certain lands (specified, with boundaries) which I had purchased after making full payment in gold. (Usual final imprecatory sentence.)

I gave the lands for the god Puṟ-iḍan-goṇḍar (the god who has taken his abode in the ant-hill), *i. e.*, Subrahmaṇya.

cells.language: Tamil
cells.remarks: (Tamil)—In the 6th year of the reign of the refuge of all the world, favourite of earth and fortune, mahārājādhirāja paramēśvara parama-bhaṭṭāraka, the glory of the Sōla race, the best of the Pōla race, destroyer of the Pāṇḍya race, a Yama to the race of Āhavamalla, vanquisher five times of Āhava- malla, Rājaśēkhara, Rājāśriya, Rāja-rājēndra, Vīra-Chōla, Karikāla-Chōla, śrī- vīra-Rājēndra-Dēvar — On the death of Śōmaraiśan, son of Muttiyaraiśan, a landholder of Puli- kkuṛukki in Koyyarkuṛai-nāḍu of Mēlai-Mārāyapāḍi in Śōla-maṇḍalam which included Iraṭṭapāḍi, his wife Piḷḷai-Ponnakkan entered the fire. As a charity for their salvation, I, Śōmaraiśan's son Mâsaiyan, granted certain lands (specified) for the god Mahādēvar. He who destroys this shall incur the sins committed ……. between the Ganges and the Kumāri.

text.location: At Brâhmaṇapalli (Śrīnivāsapur hobli), on a stone in Gôpâlayya's field.
text.remarks: (Telugu)—(On the date specified), Tâdigoḷḷa Râmappa-Nâyini Râmaṇṇa-Nâyini caused to be written and given to Brâhmaṇapalli Irugaya a *mânya-śâsana* as follows:—Your younger brother Ṭoṭaṇṇa having..our business in Digavokôṭa,—in your village…..

cells.location: At Aḍavichambukûru (Śrīnivāsapur hobli), on a stone in front of the village.
cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: (Telugu)—śrî-Râma. Be it well. (On the date specified), purifier of the Achyuta-gôtra, the mahâ-nâyakâchârya Tâdigoḷḷa Râmappa-Nâyini's grandson, Raghunâtha-Nâyini's son, Râmappa-Nâyini granted to the 25 guru Brahmans of the Mallamâmbâ agrahâra a śâsana of a gift of land as follows:—In the Koyyaguriki land of the Guḍagiri-śîme of the Pellagoṇḍa kingdom,—for Aḍavi-Chambukuruki, otherwise named the Mallamambâsamudram agrahâra, in the Bôyakâna of the Tâdigoḷḷa-Yêrukâluve-śîme belonging to our office of Nâyaka,—we grant the Kûtalanâyini tank and the new pond Liṅgani-kuṇṭa with all the dry and wet land pertaining thereto—at the time that our mother Mallayakka breathed her last…….

cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: Obeisance to Gaṇādhipati. Obeisance to the gurus. Be it well. (On the date specified), when the mahā-maṇḍalēśvara, subduer of hostile kings, champion over kings who break their word, master of the eastern southern western and northern oceans, vīra-Harihara-Rāya was in Vijayanagari, in the supreme enjoyment of the mercy of the god Virūpāksha and the favour of Vīra-Lakshmi, ruling the kingdom of the world:— and that king's son Immaḍi-Bukka-Rāya was in Muḷuvāyi, in the supreme enjoyment of the mercy of the god Sōmayya, ruling the kingdom of the earth:— in the days when that Muḷuvāyi kingdom, in the Hodali village of the Biḷusoṇe-nāḍ, Mācha-gauṇḍa's son Mārappa's (son) Chinnaṇṇa was exer- cising control in that Hodali village,— in order that merit might be to his father Mācha-gauṇḍa and his mother Maleyakka,— he set up for (the god) Vighnēśvara a dīpamāle stone pillar, to continue as long as sun and moon. Kaṭṭige Nāgappa and the Biḷusoṇe-nāḍ prabhu, Tiṇṇaḷa Chokkappa, assisted in this work of piety. Imprecation. Piṅgaṇa's son Piṅgaṇa's writing.

cells.language: Kannada
cells.remarks: Be it well. When, entitled to the band of five chief instruments, of the Pallavânvaya, favourite of earth and fortune, glory of the Pallava-kula, _śrîman_ Bira-Noḷamba was ruling the kingdom of the earth:— Rising against Sântara, forming a troop of elephants, in the battle when he was afraid, fighting and attacking him, Baṭṭamarasa pierced him in a vital part...and died. The clouds reverberated, and he was united with the celestial nymphs. For him was given...and set up this stone.....

text.location: At Himbal (Śrīnivāsapur hobli),
text.remarks:
Be it well. When Śrîpurusha-mahârâja was ruling the kingdom of the world:— and Duggamâra Ereyappa was ruling the Koḷâla-nâḍ:— Vejja-Pe[? mm]arasa, when ruling Rôṇûr, bound a badge (of honour) as ‘lord of the house’ on Sagara Mikkâṇe, and gave him, free of all imposts, one kaṇḍuga of rice land. Imprecation.

Date 1751 A. D.

(Telugu).—(In the year specified), the mahâ-nâyakâchârya Tâḍigoḷa Râ-.. Nâyini Râmappa-Nâyini granted to Tuṇḍari Chinna-Kṛishṇappa a grant of a village ....

Date 1751 A. D.

(Telugu).—Śrî-Râma. (In the year specified), the mahâ-nâyakâchârya Nija-Râmanâtha-Nâyini Râmappa-Nâyini made a grant to Biru-gavuni.

Date 1767 A. D.

(Telugu)—Be it well. (On the date specified), the mahârâja râja ....

(Telugu)—Be it well. (On the date specified), Tâdiqoḷa Tirumalappa-
Nâyini granted to Tippaya's son Timaya the Timmasamudram agrahâra.

Date ? about 1300 A. D.

(Tamil)—During the rule of Buvaneḵamalla-*maṇḍalika* Kešava-dêva—
Puṇilûr-kiḷāṉ Šivaṉâṇḍi-šeṭṭi built this tank. His son Puḷi-âḷvâṉ ? repaired it.
(Usual final imprecatory sentence ^1).)

Date about 1750 A. D.

(Telugu)—(On the date specified), the mahâ-*nâyakâchârya* Kottapalle
Raghunâtha-Nâyaka's Kaḍurappa-Nâyini made a grant of lands and tank
(specified) at Muṅgânipalli.

Date ? 1754 A. D.

(Telugu)—(On the date specified), the mahâ-*nâyakâchârya* Kottapâlya
Râma-Nâyini Nârasiṁha-Nâyini made a grant to .. kuṅku Dêviraya.

Srinivaspur Taluq.

*Date* ? about 900 *A. D.*

When, entitled to the band of five chief instruments, his breast embraced
by ......, Vaidumba-mahārāja was ruling the kingdom of the earth:— Puli-
nāḍ being seized, Rāsamayya, having requested the Haḷayūr king for a force,
attacked the Koggadi Moḷigar, smote them and died. On his dying there,
Pallava-mahārāja granted ..ndûr as a *kaḷnātu*^1), ....... Imprecation.....

*Date 1513 A. D.*

(Telugu)—May it be prosperous. Be it well. (On the date specified),
when the mahārājādhirāja rāja-paramēśvara vīra-pratāpa Kṛishṇa-Rāya-mahā
rāya was ruling the kingdom in the enjoyment of peace:— Raghupati-Nāyakā-
chârya ...... granted to various persons (named) Bâchampalli in Beleguṇḍlu
..., giving it another name of Râmapuram agrahāram. Imprecations.

lands (specified), to provide for worship, incense, lights and offerings.
Imprecations.

(Tamil)—The gift made by Dēvâṇdi-śiyan for ..........

Shoeakers shall be born in the Kāviri line........ shall incur that sin.
I, son of Kāviri-kilaivar, attained the holy feet of Śiva.
